scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You're an adventurer of this world... {0}, right? So, what can an old person like me do for you?
scripts.translation: 你是這世上的冒險者...叫{0}，對吧？找我這把老骨頭，有什麼事呀？

scripts.text: I would like a tarot card reading.
scripts.translation: 我想做塔羅牌占卜

scripts.text: What's a tarot card reading?
scripts.translation: 什麼是塔羅牌占卜？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Monster card reading uses the cards of familiar monsters around us to get advice about our future, love, and many other things.
scripts.translation: 魔物牌占卜，是藉助身邊常見魔物的卡牌，為未來、愛情等事情尋求指引。

scripts.text: A fortuneteller like me takes a question from a person and asks the card. The card answers and I tell the person.
scripts.translation: 像我這樣的占卜師，會把來人的問題交給卡牌，再將卡牌的回答轉告對方。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You should not get more than one card reading a day, and don't get one often since the card can get angry or confused.
scripts.translation: 一天最多佔卜一次，平時也不要占卜得太頻繁，否則卡牌會生氣，或是感到困惑。

scripts.text: Also, it can have a bad influence on your life, too!
scripts.translation: 這還可能給你的生活帶來不好的影響！

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: And... one more thing.
scripts.translation: 還有...

scripts.text: A card reading is only a reading... No matter how extraordinary the result may be, don't get too caught up with it. Bear that in mind.
scripts.translation: 一件事。占卜終究只是占卜...無論結果多麼驚人，也別太過沉迷。記住這一點。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Is that so...?
scripts.translation: 這樣啊.

scripts.text: Well, if you want a monster card reading, you must first show me your faith. Otherwise, the monster spirits will grow angry and place a curse on you.
scripts.translation: ..？想做魔物牌占卜，得先向我表明你的誠心。否則，魔物之靈會發怒，對你降下詛咒。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: So, would you like a monster card reading?
scripts.translation: 那麼，要做一次魔物牌占卜嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: I would like to think it over once more.
scripts.translation: 我想再考慮一下

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Ok then. Young adventurer, may luck be with you...
scripts.translation: 那好吧。年輕的冒險者，願好運與你同在...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Then...
scripts.translation: 那麼...

scripts.text: Please pay your fee with all of your sincerity.
scripts.translation: 請懷著誠意，付上占卜的費用。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You have angered the monster spirits!
scripts.translation: 你惹怒了魔物之靈！

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: There's no need to overdo it. Just give with all your heart... *Tsk tsk*
scripts.translation: 倒也不必這麼破費，只要心意到了就好...*嘖嘖*

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: I accept your heart and your devotion with my gratitude. Thoughts are more important than the amount when paying a fortune teller.
scripts.translation: 你的心意和誠意，我感激地收下了。付給占卜師的錢，心意比金額更重要。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Then, I will begin to tell the fortune of your wish. Concentrate on yourself...
scripts.translation: 那麼，我就開始為你心中所願占卜。集中精神...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Clear your mind...
scripts.translation: 清空思緒...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Once you have emptied your mind, think of the thing you most wish to know.
scripts.translation: 心中雜念散去後，想一想你最想知道的事。

scripts.text: (I would like to know my love fortune.)
scripts.translation: （我想知道自己的愛情運勢）

scripts.text: (How rich will I be?)
scripts.translation: （我能有多富裕？）

scripts.text: (I need advice about my future.)
scripts.translation: （我需要對未來的指引）

scripts.text: (Can I get a warning of any dangers awaiting?)
scripts.translation: （能預知我將遇到的危險嗎？）

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: I see it... I see a sign of love...
scripts.translation: 我看到了...愛情的徵兆...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You are afraid to show yourself working, to your loved one..
scripts.translation: 你害怕讓愛人看到自己工作時的模樣..

scripts.text: But that is not love. Do not be afraid to show different sides of yourself to your loved one..
scripts.translation: .但這樣可不算愛。別害怕向愛人展現自己不同的一面...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: So do not worry and move on.
scripts.translation: 所以別擔心，繼續向前吧。

scripts.text: Maybe you are using love as an excuse to work? The card is saying to try observing love from a different perspective.
scripts.translation: 也許，你是在以愛為藉口去工作？卡牌建議你換個角度看待愛情。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Shoveling requires skills as well.
scripts.translation: 鏟土也是要講技巧的。

scripts.text: How about taking a break from love and giving yourself time to relax.. I agree with what the card is saying.
scripts.translation: 不妨暫時放下愛情，給自己一點放鬆的時間...我也贊同卡牌的建議。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Love is not meant to be so hard.
scripts.translation: 愛情本不該這麼艱難。

scripts.text: A shovel..?
scripts.translation: 一把鏟子...？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Strange that this would come up about love.. bizarre.. You aren't using this shovel to take revenge on someone, are you??
scripts.translation: 奇怪，愛情怎麼會抽出這張牌...真古怪...你不會要拿這把鏟子報復誰吧？

scripts.text: Don't get malicious thoughts. Keep a kind heart.
scripts.translation: ？別動惡念，要心存善意。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: How about taking a break from love and giving yourself time to relax.. I agree with this card.
scripts.translation: 不妨暫時放下愛情，給自己一點放鬆的時間...我也贊同這張牌。

scripts.text: Its pure eyes look at a loved one but cannot recognize them, the wings flutter towards the loved one, but it helplessly stays in one place,
scripts.translation: 它用純淨的眼睛望著愛人，卻認不出對方。它朝愛人振翅，卻無奈地停在原地。

scripts.text: it calls its loved one, but they cannot hear..
scripts.translation: 它呼喚愛人，對方卻聽不見...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: What a sad fortune..
scripts.translation: 真是悲傷的運勢...

scripts.text: Indeed, it is sad love... it might be hard to overcome.
scripts.translation: 這的確是一段悲傷的愛情...恐怕很難克服。

scripts.text: The passion of love like a raging wave... You can't even hide it.
scripts.translation: 愛意如怒濤般洶湧...藏也藏不住。

scripts.text: With such passionate love, isn't there only one way..?
scripts.translation: 如此熱烈的愛，難道不是隻有一條路可走...？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Passionate love is nearby. It is a good sign.
scripts.translation: 熾熱的愛情就在身邊。這是個好兆頭。

scripts.text: The teeth of dustiness are very strong. This means.. use your teeth for victory?!
scripts.translation: 獵蠅的牙齒很堅硬。這意思是...用牙齒贏得勝利？！

scripts.text: The card is telling me, 'Fly to your loved one as you were a butterfly and shoot at it as you were a star.'
scripts.translation: 卡牌告訴我：“像蝴蝶一樣飛向愛人，像流星一樣奔向對方。”

scripts.text: ..even though it doesn't sound like something a moth would say.
scripts.translation: ...雖然這話聽著可不像飛蛾會說的。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: The passion of love like a raging wave.. You can't even hide it.
scripts.translation: 愛意如怒濤般洶湧...藏也藏不住。

scripts.text: Perhaps the person you believe to be a butterfly is actually a moth. This fortune is awaiting a prudent judgement.
scripts.translation: 也許，你以為是蝴蝶的那個人，其實是一隻飛蛾。這次的占卜提醒你，要謹慎判斷。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Love is indeed a subject to be dealt with prudence. Keep that in mind young one.
scripts.translation: 愛情的確要謹慎對待。年輕人，記住這一點。

scripts.text: The one you love will give you a kiss of death.
scripts.translation: 你愛的人會給你一個死亡之吻。

scripts.text: The irresistable kiss.. It is up to you to decide whether to avoid it or not.
scripts.translation: 那是個難以抗拒的吻...要不要避開，全由你決定。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Charisma... is the sweetest poison.
scripts.translation: 魅力...是最甜蜜的毒藥。

scripts.text: You are looking at a wonderful person, but their eyes are fixed in darkness.
scripts.translation: 你望著一位美好的人，可對方的目光卻停留在黑暗中。

scripts.text: How about trying to grab their attention?
scripts.translation: 不妨試著吸引對方的注意？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: so, you need to try something other than charisma.
scripts.translation: 所以，別光靠魅力，也試試別的辦法。

scripts.text: Your love needs fresh blood. Healthy exercises and eating habits are necessary!
scripts.translation: 你的愛情需要新鮮血液。適當運動、健康飲食，都少不了！

scripts.text: You must change your living pattern first.
scripts.translation: 先改變自己的生活習慣吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Health is the best.
scripts.translation: 健康才是最重要的。

scripts.text: Don't you think you are infatuated by outer appearance and gambling with love? You might have to be more careful about it this time.
scripts.translation: 你是不是被外表迷住，正在拿愛情冒險？這次可得更謹慎些。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Beauty is only skin deep.
scripts.translation: 美貌只是皮相。

scripts.text: Become a pirate of love! It is a simple, yet strong fortune!
scripts.translation: 成為愛情的海盜吧！這預言簡單，卻很有力量！

scripts.text: No matter how romantic and beautiful love is, it is not rightful, it is undesirable..
scripts.translation: 無論這份愛多麼浪漫美麗，它都不正當，也不可取...

scripts.text: is what this card means.
scripts.translation: 這就是卡牌的意思。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: I hope you are not disappointed by the moral of this fortune.
scripts.translation: 希望這次占卜的寓意不會讓你失望。

scripts.text: In the rough sea called the world, only pirates, the outlaws of love, are the law.
scripts.translation: 在名為世界的洶湧大海上，海盜這些愛情的法外之徒，反而就是法則。

scripts.text: This card supports strong love.
scripts.translation: 這張牌支援強勢的愛情。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You must overcome it - no matter how strong the wave is.
scripts.translation: 不管浪潮多麼洶湧，你都得跨過去。

scripts.text: It is a warning not to get involved in false love like pirated editions!
scripts.translation: 卡牌在警告你，別陷入盜版般虛假的愛情！

scripts.text: You may have to reconsider your love right now.
scripts.translation: 也許，你該重新審視眼前這份愛了。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Illegal copying is not love!
scripts.translation: 非法複製不是愛！

scripts.text: This is praising the type of love that is always there, yet barely has a form as it does not exist.
scripts.translation: 這張牌讚美的，是一種始終存在，卻無形無跡、彷彿不存在的愛。

scripts.text: Are you involved this type of love?
scripts.translation: 你正經歷著這樣的愛嗎？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Love's form is obscure.
scripts.translation: 愛情的模樣，總是朦朧難辨。

scripts.text: You must be careful. Love is quietly approaching and spreading poison. Be careful of the poison of love.
scripts.translation: 你得小心。愛情正悄悄靠近，散播毒素。當心愛情的毒。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: There is no cure for this poison!
scripts.translation: 這種毒藥無藥可解！

scripts.text: Aren't you already caught in love that you cannot run away from? Look around you.
scripts.translation: 你是不是已經陷入一段無法逃脫的愛情？看看四周吧。

scripts.text: You might be captured inside invisible walls.
scripts.translation: 也許，你正被無形的牆困住。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You have been blinded by love and became a prisoner! Shouldn't you escape?
scripts.translation: 你被愛情矇住了眼，成了囚徒！還不該逃出去嗎？

scripts.text: This fortune is saying that love is.. approaching wobbly and softly~ and then bam~ embracing it.
scripts.translation: 這次占卜說，愛情會...搖搖晃晃、輕輕柔柔地靠過來~然後，啪~一把抱住。

scripts.text: Very romantic. Hehe.
scripts.translation: 真浪漫呀，呵呵。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Romance is the best part of love~
scripts.translation: 浪漫是愛情中最美好的部分~

scripts.text: This card is warning you to not treat your loved one like a puppet.
scripts.translation: 這張牌提醒你，別把愛人當成提線木偶。

scripts.text: You're not doing this, are you?
scripts.translation: 你沒有這麼做吧？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Love is not supposed to be about controlling and restraining~ mm~
scripts.translation: 愛情不該是控制和束縛~嗯~

scripts.text: Dolls understand a human's heart more than a human. Try treating your loved one as they were a doll.
scripts.translation: 玩偶比人更懂人心。試著像對待玩偶一樣，對待你的愛人吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Your loved one can't be worse than a doll, can they?
scripts.translation: 你的愛人總不會還不如一個玩偶吧？

scripts.text: you are afraid to look into a doll's eyes, that is because there is a dark shadow covering your love.
scripts.translation: 你害怕直視玩偶的眼睛，是因為陰影籠罩著你的愛情。

scripts.text: Rid yourselves of that shadow. Then the doll will smile as well.
scripts.translation: 驅散那片陰影，玩偶也會露出笑容。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: That is what love is.
scripts.translation: 這就是愛情。

scripts.text: Dolls become accustomed to the owner the more they are handled. Give your doll more attention.
scripts.translation: 玩偶被主人把玩得越多，就越熟悉主人。多給你的玩偶一些關心吧。

scripts.text: The doll is craving attention. A lot of attention.
scripts.translation: 它渴望關注，非常渴望。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Delicate treatment and attention is the best in love.
scripts.translation: 愛情裡最重要的，是細心呵護和關心。

scripts.text: Do you fear the snake hair of a Medusa? However, love cannot be achieved with fear.
scripts.translation: 你害怕米杜沙的蛇發嗎？可心懷恐懼，是無法贏得愛情的。

scripts.text: You must move forward!
scripts.translation: 你必須向前邁進！

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Love must be pushed forward!
scripts.translation: 愛情需要主動向前！

scripts.text: Warriors that hastily attacked the Medusa all failed, but the one hero that used a mirror succeeded.
scripts.translation: 魯莽進攻米杜沙的戰士都失敗了，唯獨那位藉助鏡子的英雄成功了。

scripts.text: You cannot succeed in love with brute force. You must use wisdom.
scripts.translation: 愛情也不能靠蠻力取勝，要用智慧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Do you understand what I mean young one?
scripts.translation: 年輕人，你明白我的意思嗎？

scripts.text: Must you love the one that has hair of snakes? Reconsider this love and think about it earnestly.
scripts.translation: 你非要愛上那個長著蛇發的人嗎？重新審視這份愛，好好想一想吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: What do you think? Isn't this a great opportunity to ponder about the relationship.
scripts.translation: 你覺得呢？這不正是好好思考這段關係的機會嗎？

scripts.text: It is a hint saying that a strong hairstyle is the key to turning over the situation. Change your hairstyle!
scripts.translation: 卡牌暗示，醒目的髮型是扭轉局面的關鍵。換個髮型吧！

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Fashion is in the hands of those who are ahead!
scripts.translation: 時尚掌握在走在前沿的人手裡！

scripts.text: Love must have two things: great strength and the will to live. Have you thought about whether or not you can overcome this with your current self?
scripts.translation: 愛情需要兩樣東西：強大的力量，以及活下去的意志。你想過嗎，現在的自己能否克服眼前的困難？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Know love and know thyself!
scripts.translation: 懂得愛情，也認清自己！

scripts.text: A scythe may seem burdensome but a strong Baphomet can freely use it.
scripts.translation: 鐮刀看著沉重，強大的巴風特卻能揮舞自如。

scripts.text: It is the same concept. you are ready, any type of love is possible. There is no such thing as impossible.
scripts.translation: 愛情也是這個道理。只要準備好了，什麼樣的愛都能實現，沒有什麼不可能。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Love requires preparation as well!
scripts.translation: 愛情也需要準備！

scripts.text: Love must have two things: great strength and the will to live. Have you thought about whether or not you can overcome this with your current self?
scripts.translation: 愛情需要兩樣東西：強大的力量，以及活下去的意志。你想過嗎，現在的自己能否克服眼前的困難？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Know love and know thyself!
scripts.translation: 懂得愛情，也認清自己！

scripts.text: There are those who are born, destined to run into this wall, an obstacle. Your love seems to have reached that wall.. It must be hard.
scripts.translation: 有些人天生就註定會碰上這堵牆，這道障礙。你的愛情似乎也到了這道牆前...一定很難受吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: What a pity.
scripts.translation: 真可惜。

scripts.text: This Baphomet looks as it is having a hard time. The person must be exhausted even it may not seem so.
scripts.translation: 這隻巴風特看起來很辛苦。那個人即使表面上不露聲色，也一定已經疲憊不堪了。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Approach then with affection.
scripts.translation: 那就懷著愛意，去接近對方吧。

scripts.text: Can't you hear the cry of the card? It is suffering. Love is like that..
scripts.translation: 你聽不見卡牌的哀鳴嗎？它正在受苦。愛情就是這樣...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: So don't be upset about it!
scripts.translation: 所以，別為這事難過！

scripts.text: Your love right now is so bored that it is yawning. How about trying something fresh and new?
scripts.translation: 你眼下的愛情無聊得都打哈欠了。不妨試點新鮮的花樣？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Try changing your dating style.
scripts.translation: 試著換一種約會方式吧。

scripts.text: Deep sleep brings happiness and dreams. I think what you need right now is sleep.
scripts.translation: 酣睡能帶來幸福與美夢。我想，你現在需要的是好好睡一覺。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Get some sleep.
scripts.translation: 去睡一覺吧。

scripts.text: I feel some sort of emptiness.. Maybe there is a gap in your love?
scripts.translation: 我感到一種空虛...也許，你的愛情裡有什麼空缺？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Take a close look.
scripts.translation: 仔細看一看。

scripts.text: Even a traditional beauty can seem cold to others. Try looking at your loved one from a different point of view.
scripts.translation: 即使是古典美人，在別人眼裡也可能顯得冷淡。試著換個角度看看你的愛人吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Look at love from a different perspective. You never know when you'll be able to discover something.
scripts.translation: 換個角度看愛情吧。說不定什麼時候，就會有新的發現。

scripts.text: They may seem dreary and ominous but their attire is spotless. They show devotion to the other.
scripts.translation: 對方看著陰鬱不祥，衣著卻一塵不染，透著對另一半的用心。

scripts.text: Even though you are not satisfied with your love right now, take a look at their attire.
scripts.translation: 即使你對眼下的愛情不太滿意，也看看對方的衣著吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: it is carefully worn, their heart for you can be seen in it as well..
scripts.translation: 對方穿戴得很用心，從中也能看見對你的心意...

scripts.text: There is a person you must not deal with thoughtlessly nearby. Don't say or do anything carelessly. You must be careful when dealing with this person.
scripts.translation: 你身邊有個不能輕率對待的人。別隨口說話，也別隨意行事。和這個人相處，要多加小心。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Bear that in mind.
scripts.translation: 記住這一點。

scripts.text: Even the wind blows and the trail of her clothes flutter, her posture never changes. Loving a person with that type of heart will bring goodwill and happiness.
scripts.translation: 任憑風吹動她的衣襬，她的姿態也始終不變。愛上心性如此堅定的人，會帶來善意與幸福。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Keep a righteous heart and mind.
scripts.translation: 心存正直，念頭也要端正。

scripts.text: That lightens and attacks with a pickaxe! You must aggressively move forward. What do you think? Your fortune is a good one.
scripts.translation: 它照亮前方，揮起鎬頭進攻！你也得積極向前。怎麼樣？你的運勢不錯。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Is your heart ready young one?
scripts.translation: 年輕人，你心裡準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: The card only shows gaunt bones, but notice how it has all the necessary tools?
scripts.translation: 牌上只有一副瘦骨架，可你注意到了嗎？它該有的工具一樣不少。

scripts.text: Even though your love right now may seem as there is nothing to it, it has everything you need.
scripts.translation: 你眼下的愛情看著似乎一無所有，其實所需的一切都已具備。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Don't get too greedy about things.
scripts.translation: 不要太貪心。

scripts.text: It has a lantern on its back and even in its hand.. it believes one light is insufficient.
scripts.translation: 它背上有燈籠，手裡也有一盞...看來覺得一盞燈還不夠亮。

scripts.text: you are only shining one type of light to your loved one, shining another might help.
scripts.translation: 你照向愛人的光芒只有一種，也許再添一道光會有所幫助。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: They might be feeling that one is not enough.
scripts.translation: 也許，對方覺得一個還不夠。

scripts.text: You know the smile of Mona Lisa.. Perhaps the person you are looking at has the same expression?
scripts.translation: 你知道蒙娜麗莎的微笑吧...也許，你注視的那個人也有同樣的神情？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Don't try to gaze straight them. Make an effort to approach them.
scripts.translation: 別隻是直勾勾地盯著對方，要努力靠近。

scripts.text: A knight on a horse is a fantasy in every person's heart. Make it so that this fantasy becomes real.
scripts.translation: 騎在馬上的騎士，是每個人心中的幻想。讓這份幻想變成現實吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Then there will surely be progress.
scripts.translation: 這樣，一定會有進展。

scripts.text: Is that soldier waiting to attack? I can feel great tension between the horse and knight.
scripts.translation: 那名戰士是在等待進攻嗎？我能感到馬與騎士之間強烈的緊張氣氛。

scripts.text: Don't run forward carelessly. Raise your sword and wait for your chance.
scripts.translation: 別貿然衝上去，舉起劍，等待時機。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: This means now is a time to wait. How about it, would you like to wait a while?
scripts.translation: 這說明，現在應該等待。怎麼樣，要不要耐心等一陣？

scripts.text: He is falling asleep awaiting a battle. Is it because he is laid back, or simply pathetic? Depends on the situation I suppose.
scripts.translation: 等著開戰，他卻快睡著了。是太悠閒，還是太沒出息？恐怕得看情況。

scripts.text: But you've got to give him credit for his boldness.
scripts.translation: 不過，這份膽量還是值得佩服。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: How about becoming a brave warrior in the battle of love?
scripts.translation: 不如在愛情的戰場上，做個勇敢的戰士？

scripts.text: Very favorable. It's to a point that I can feel strong energy from the card. I will give some of this energy to you.
scripts.translation: 大吉。我甚至能感到卡牌散發著強大的能量。就把其中一些傳給你吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Devote that energy to love..!
scripts.translation: 把那份精力投入愛情吧...！

scripts.text: What does the god of death have to say about love? It is something ominous for sure.
scripts.translation: 死神對愛情能有什麼話說呢？想必不是什麼好兆頭。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: I think it is trying to give a warning. Be careful.
scripts.translation: 我想，這是在發出警告。多加小心。

scripts.text: Hmm. How about giving a cute puppy as a gift? One with a round nose. Then they will surely be happy.
scripts.translation: 嗯，送只可愛的小狗怎麼樣？要鼻子圓圓的那種。對方一定會很高興。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: But can't help it they don't like puppies.
scripts.translation: 不過，對方要是不喜歡小狗，那也沒辦法。

scripts.text: I can tell what it was doing from the way it is crying while holding an axe with blood. It is deeply wounded by love.
scripts.translation: 它握著染血的斧頭哭泣，光看這模樣，就知道它做過什麼。愛情讓它傷得很深。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: that wound isn't cured soon, it will become as Anubis wanted.
scripts.translation: 傷口要是不盡快治好，就會讓安畢斯如願。

scripts.text: The pattern of the clothes symbolizes a warning. It is saying to be careful of love.
scripts.translation: 衣服上的圖案是個警告。它在提醒你，當心愛情。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Be cautious.
scripts.translation: 多加小心。

scripts.text: He is a warning you not to drool over someone else.
scripts.translation: 他在警告你，別對別人垂涎三尺。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: That's bad! You will be punished!
scripts.translation: 這可不行！你會受到懲罰的！

scripts.text: Who is he so fiercly gazing at with those grand muscles? He is looking at someone else for sure.
scripts.translation: 他一身壯碩的肌肉，正凶狠地盯著誰呢？肯定是在看別的人。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Don't get sidetracked and look elsewhere! You will be cursed!
scripts.translation: 別分心去看別人！否則會受到詛咒！

scripts.text: Strengthen your body and observe the target. That is the step to success.
scripts.translation: 鍛鍊身體，仔細觀察目標。這才是走向成功的辦法。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: you want love as well, why don't you take the card's advice and prepare yourself first?
scripts.translation: 你也想要愛情的話，不妨聽聽卡牌的建議，先做好準備？

scripts.text: His navel is very pretty. You have to meet someone with that type of navel to be happy.
scripts.translation: 他的肚臍真漂亮。你得找個有這種肚臍的人，才能幸福。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Ok? Keep that in mind~
scripts.translation: 好嗎？記住了~

scripts.text: You'll get hurt you mess around. This card is giving you a piece of advice.
scripts.translation: 胡亂來，可是會受傷的。這就是卡牌給你的忠告。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You did something wrong to your loved one, didn't you? Make an effort to make up for it~!
scripts.translation: 你是不是做了什麼對不起愛人的事？努力彌補吧~！

scripts.text: From the way he is massaging its back because of a shoulder cramp, maybe your love is seeking someone to massage them. Love starts from little thoughts.
scripts.translation: 看他肩膀抽筋、揉著背的樣子，也許你的愛人正盼著有人替自己按摩。愛情始於一點一滴的關心。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Next time you meet them, give them a massage. Start with the little things.
scripts.translation: 下次見面，替對方按摩一下吧。就從這些小事做起。

scripts.text: His expression is in awe. When encountering an absurd incident, his face and expression becomes peculiarly distorted.
scripts.translation: 他一臉驚愕。碰上荒唐事，面容和神情就會變得扭曲古怪。

scripts.text: I think the one you are looking towards has that type of expression.
scripts.translation: 我想，你注視的那個人也有這樣的表情。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Did you do something absurd to that person? Are you sure? Think about it~
scripts.translation: 你有沒有對那個人做過什麼荒唐事？確定嗎？好好想想~

scripts.text: the lover does something wrong he pokes them with a needle. How scary..
scripts.translation: 愛人一做錯事，他就用針戳對方。真可怕...

scripts.text: A person's heart is like this card. you flip it over nobody can tell what is behind it. Try turning the person's card over.
scripts.translation: 人心就像這張牌，翻到背面，誰也看不見裡面藏著什麼。試著翻開那個人心裡的牌吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You must approach their true heart. Understand?
scripts.translation: 你得走近對方真正的內心。明白嗎？

scripts.text: Jokers are sly, but that is just because it is their habit.
scripts.translation: 裘卡很狡猾，但那只是它的習性。

scripts.text: The reason the person may seem capricious or cunning is partially because they are born like that.
scripts.translation: 那個人顯得善變或狡詐，也有一部分是天性使然。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Will you be able to approach them regardless? To do so, you must prepare you heart.. mm..
scripts.translation: 即便如此，你還是能走近對方嗎？想做到這一點，得先做好心理準備...嗯...

scripts.text: The joker can't use any of his strength because he is tied to a card. Perhaps the person is caught in something and can't show their true merit?
scripts.translation: 裘卡被綁在卡牌上，有力氣也使不出來。也許，那個人正被什麼束縛著，無法展現真正的才能？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: you love them, free them from the chains tying them down.. That is consideration.. and love
scripts.translation: 愛對方，就解開束縛對方的鎖鏈...這就是體貼...也是愛。

scripts.text: Don't get fooled by tricks. They are a person, too. They know how to lie once in a while. Search for the trick calmly and carefully.
scripts.translation: 別被花招騙了。對方也是人，偶爾也會撒謊。冷靜些，仔細看穿其中的詭計。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: And then search for a different route. That is the wise decision.
scripts.translation: 然後，再找一條別的路。這才是明智的選擇。

scripts.text: It is saying that daring action is necessary, such as that of the Hode that strikes up from the sand.
scripts.translation: 卡牌說，你需要大膽行動，就像蚯蚓突然從沙裡竄出來那樣。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Maybe you are discouraged a little too much right now. Be brave and daring young one.
scripts.translation: 也許，你現在太灰心了。年輕人，勇敢大膽些。

scripts.text: Seeing that the Hode spits out sand to those who bother them, you must have done something to bother the person somehow.
scripts.translation: 蚯蚓會向打擾它的人噴沙。看來，你也做了什麼事，惹得那個人不快。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Maybe you are being troublesome? Make an effort to relax a little more.
scripts.translation: 也許，你有些太煩人了？試著再放鬆些。

scripts.text: The Hode has a very strong will to live. It is to survive in the forest. It is suggesting dating with that kind of will.
scripts.translation: 蚯蚓有著頑強的求生意志，才能在森林裡活下去。它建議你，也拿出這樣的意志去戀愛。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Hmm, try love with more spirit. You will get good results.
scripts.translation: 嗯，拿出更多熱情去戀愛吧。會有好結果的。

scripts.text: Ah.. there is a noble person up north. North it is. This direction will never change.
scripts.translation: 啊...北方有一位高貴的人。就是北方，這個方向不會變。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Trust me and go for it.
scripts.translation: 相信我，放手去做吧。

scripts.text: A walking bull is rare. The person you are looking towards is that rare. Don't let go of them. You may never see them again..
scripts.translation: 會走路的公牛很少見。你注視的那個人，也一樣難得。別放手，也許錯過了就再也見不到...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: The card is saying this.
scripts.translation: 卡牌就是這麼說的。

scripts.text: Can you see the strong muscles that even arrows cannot pierce? The person is like that, too.
scripts.translation: 看見那連箭都射不穿的強壯肌肉了嗎？那個人也是如此。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: To attack with love.. you will need a stronger attack.. Mmm..
scripts.translation: 想用愛進攻...攻勢得再強一些...嗯...

scripts.text: The scariest thing is not the hammer nor horn. It is the massive legs that support its heavy weight. Nobody can survive a hit by those legs. The person is also probably hiding the most dangerous part.
scripts.translation: 最可怕的不是錘子，也不是角，而是撐起沉重身軀的巨大雙腿。捱上一腳，誰也活不了。那個人或許也藏著最危險的一面。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You must love but be careful at the same time. You never know when you will be hit by the hind legs.
scripts.translation: 去愛，也要同時小心。誰知道什麼時候，會被後腿踢上一腳。

scripts.text: No matter how fearful the bull may be, it has a nose ring, it has already been tamed by humans. No matter how astonishing that person may be, taming is your responsibility.
scripts.translation: 公牛再可怕，戴上鼻環，就說明已經被人馴服。那個人再了不起，也得由你來馴服。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Approach them with more sincerity and consideration.
scripts.translation: 帶著更多的真誠和體貼，去接近對方吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You seeked advice about love.
scripts.translation: 你尋求的是愛情方面的指引。

scripts.text: Even if you may not pleased with it, consider it calmly and make an effort to find true happiness.
scripts.translation: 即使結果不合心意，也要冷靜思考，努力找到真正的幸福。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Then...
scripts.translation: 那麼...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Ooh... something about your fortune is starting to show...
scripts.translation: 噢...你的運勢開始顯現了...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You must work hard to become wealthy. Don't think of other things.. Focus on and put effort into achieving your goals.
scripts.translation: 想發財，就得努力工作。別想其他事...專注於目標，踏踏實實地努力。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Then good luck and try your best.
scripts.translation: 那麼祝你好運，加油吧。

scripts.text: Something very rare may come your way. A gold mine has been the dream of many since ancient times. You have a gold mine right in front of you.
scripts.translation: 你可能會遇上難得的機會。自古以來，無數人夢想著找到金礦。而你面前，就有一座金礦。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: All in all, a big fortune is right in front of your eyes. I'll be looking forward to it.
scripts.translation: 總之，一筆豐厚的財富就在你眼前。我等著看呢。

scripts.text: In the stomach pocket, there must be a secret treasure. There may be something in your pocket as well.
scripts.translation: 腹部的口袋裡，一定藏著秘密寶藏。也許，你的口袋裡也藏著什麼。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Are you hiding things from other people? You should get rid of them. They may bring bad luck.
scripts.translation: 你是不是藏著什麼，不讓別人知道？最好處理掉那些東西，它們可能帶來厄運。

scripts.text: The card says that you should not be too greedy, for that may cause you to dig your own grave.
scripts.translation: 卡牌說，別太貪心，否則可能會自掘墳墓。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You may not feel good about it, but you should accept the card's advice..!
scripts.translation: 也許你不太願意聽，可還是該接受卡牌的建議...！

scripts.text: Did you know that a moth's wings has infinite amounts of powder on it? A moth symbolizes wealth in the sense that it can gather wealth just as the powder on its wings.
scripts.translation: 你知道嗎？飛蛾翅膀上的粉末多得數不清。它能像積累翅粉一樣積聚財富，所以是財富的象徵。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Young one, you will gather much wealth.
scripts.translation: 年輕人，你會積攢不少財富。

scripts.text: You must work hard to become wealthy. Don't think of other things. Simply focusing on your goals putting effort into it will help.
scripts.translation: 想發財，就得努力工作。別想其他事。專注於目標，付出努力，就會有所幫助。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Good luck and try your best.
scripts.translation: 祝你好運，加油吧。

scripts.text: There is a common saying that when a moth flaps its wings, wealth will fly away as well. It's not a very good sign.
scripts.translation: 俗話說，飛蛾一振翅，財富也會跟著飛走。這可不是什麼好兆頭。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Be careful not to lose your assets. Take good care of your wallet.
scripts.translation: 小心，別丟了錢財。看好自己的錢包。

scripts.text: Dustiness teeth are very strong. This means..
scripts.translation: 獵蠅的牙齒很堅硬。這意味著...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Your tooth will become a gold tooth?!
scripts.translation: 你的牙齒會變成金牙？！

scripts.text: When a dustiness flies around, a big expense comes up. You may need to spend some money soon.
scripts.translation: 獵蠅四處飛舞，就意味著一筆大開銷。你近期可能要花些錢。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You might want to set up a budget to prepare for this expense.
scripts.translation: 最好先做好預算，為這筆開銷留出錢。

scripts.text: Dracula brings in money. Maybe it is the moral influence from when it was a count. It is expensive to be a vampire, but I've never seen a poor one before.
scripts.translation: 德古拉會帶來金錢。也許是他曾身為伯爵留下的影響。做吸血鬼開銷不小，可我還沒見過窮吸血鬼。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You don't need to worry about money.
scripts.translation: 你不必為錢擔心。

scripts.text: To Dracula, money is not important. Blood is more valuable. To you, money must not be that important. You don't need to be concerned about money.
scripts.translation: 對德古拉來說，錢不重要，血才更有價值。對你而言，錢想必也沒那麼重要。不必為錢擔心。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: How about it? Try being a little more casual about money.
scripts.translation: 怎麼樣？試著把錢看淡一點吧。

scripts.text: Dracula mocks human's money. To him it is worthless.
scripts.translation: 德古拉嘲笑人類的金錢。對他來說，那毫無價值。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You should not be so concerned about money and assets, too.
scripts.translation: 你也別太在意金錢和財產。

scripts.text: No matter what, stealing is wrong! Even a Drake blesses you in the name of pirates! Stealing is forbidden!
scripts.translation: 無論如何，偷東西都不對！哪怕海盜之王以海盜之名為你祝福，也不許偷竊！

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Noooooooo stealing!
scripts.translation: 不——許——偷東西！

scripts.text: You will gather good fortune in a secretive and peculiar way.. Although, there seems to be shadows over some parts of your life.
scripts.translation: 你會以隱秘而奇特的方式得到好運...不過，生活中的某些地方似乎也蒙著陰影。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: It's an uneasy fortune. Are you ready?
scripts.translation: 這個預言讓人不安。你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: The reason pirates indulge in others assets in the vast rough ocean, is because it is the only way to let the people of the land know of their existence.
scripts.translation: 海盜在廣闊而洶湧的大海上搶奪他人的財產，因為唯有這樣，陸地上的人才會知道他們的存在。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: But those who live on land do not need to do so. Don't look over other people's belongings. It is the advice of a pirate.
scripts.translation: 可住在陸地上的人，不必這麼做。別覬覦別人的財物。這是海盜給你的忠告。

scripts.text: Marina prefers clean funds. It hates suspicious money. Your possessions should be clean as well.
scripts.translation: 水母喜歡來路清白的錢，討厭可疑的錢財。你的財產也該來得乾乾淨淨。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Why? The Marina might get rid of it all.
scripts.translation: 為什麼？水母可能會把那些錢全丟掉。

scripts.text: The Marina gathers money quietly, little by little, and freely roaming at the same time. That's the real way to make money. The Marina is suggesting this method to you.
scripts.translation: 水母一邊自由遊蕩，一邊悄悄地、一點一點地積攢錢財。這才是真正的賺錢之道。它也建議你這麼做。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You should take a shot at it. You've got nothing to lose.
scripts.translation: 不妨試試看，反正也沒什麼損失。

scripts.text: The Marina is not interested in money. The card suggests that you will resemble these traits as well. You will enjoy life apart from money.
scripts.translation: 水母對錢沒興趣。卡牌暗示，你也會像它一樣，不受金錢束縛，享受生活。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: That's the fortune from a Marina card.
scripts.translation: 這就是水母牌給出的預言。

scripts.text: You will gather money swiftly and quietly, then boom~ blow it all at once.
scripts.translation: 你會迅速而悄悄地攢下錢，然後，轟~一口氣全花光。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Very witty, hoho.
scripts.translation: 真機智，呵呵。

scripts.text: The Marionette treasures art over wealth. Bear that in mind. Honor over assets.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃看重藝術，勝過財富。記住，榮譽比財產更重要。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: What an important lesson.. Mmm...
scripts.translation: 多重要的一課啊...嗯...

scripts.text: The Marionette likes shiny money. Not dull money, but the shiny kind.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃喜歡閃閃發亮的錢。不是暗淡無光的那種，得是亮晶晶的。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Anyways, search for that type of money.
scripts.translation: 總之，去找那種錢吧。

scripts.text: The Marionette requires lots of money. Its expenditures are enormous. You must have many expenditures ahead of you.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃需要很多錢，開銷大得驚人。看來，你接下來也有不少要花錢的地方。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: A gloomy fortune. How about being cautious?
scripts.translation: 這預言有些陰沉。還是謹慎些吧？

scripts.text: The Marionette uses a lot of money. There is someone around you that is like that, too.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃花錢如流水。你身邊也有這樣的人。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: There is a person like that for sure. You should watch out.
scripts.translation: 一定有這樣的人。你可得提防。

scripts.text: The hair of the Medusa symbolizes the amount of wealth. Seems as something good will happen to you, young one.
scripts.translation: 米杜沙的頭髮，象徵著財富的多少。年輕人，看來你會遇到好事。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You can look forward to it.
scripts.translation: 你可以期待一下。

scripts.text: The hair of the Medusa are all snakes. Snakes symbolize greed and slyness. When gathering things, it seems as a cunning force will join you. It's not exactly a bright sign..
scripts.translation: 米杜沙的頭髮全是蛇，而蛇象徵貪婪與狡詐。你積聚財富時，似乎會有一股狡詐的力量相助。這可不算什麼好兆頭...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: But you surely will get money. Hmm..
scripts.translation: 不過，你肯定會得到錢。嗯...

scripts.text: The Medusa is strongly recommending saving. This card is telling you to save. It says to put many savings accounts in your hair and make yourself resemble its head shape.
scripts.translation: 米杜沙強烈建議你儲蓄。這張牌就是在催你存錢。它讓你把許多儲蓄賬戶放進頭髮裡，讓自己的頭型像它一樣。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: That is what it believes to be wealth. Oooh!
scripts.translation: 在它看來，那才是財富。噢！

scripts.text: The Medusa does not enjoy playing with money. you are attempting to use money other than the way it should be used, you should stop. Why?
scripts.translation: 米杜沙不喜歡拿錢胡鬧。要是你想把錢用在不該用的地方，就該停手。為什麼？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Because there can be a curse of the Medusa.
scripts.translation: 因為可能會招來米杜沙的詛咒。

scripts.text: The great strength of the Baphomet brings in fortune. It seems as you will be able to gather much wealth with the aid of the Baphomet's force!
scripts.translation: 巴風特的強大力量會帶來財運。看來，藉助它的力量，你能積攢不少財富！

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: It's a good sign! Congratulations!
scripts.translation: 這是個好兆頭！恭喜！

scripts.text: The scythe of the Baphomet means a strong tool to gather wealth. you have a strong tool like his, it should be easy to gather wealth.
scripts.translation: 巴風特的鐮刀，象徵著積聚財富的利器。如果你也有這樣的利器，賺錢應該很容易。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: What the Baphomet is trying to say is, find a mean that can help you like his tool.
scripts.translation: 巴風特想說的是，找個能像它的工具一樣幫到你的辦法。

scripts.text: How about getting involved in raising cattle? It seems like you can gather much wealth through it.
scripts.translation: 不如試試養牛？看來，這能讓你積攢不少財富。

scripts.text: The Baphomet would like a tribute. He is saying that you do, he will return great benefits.
scripts.translation: 巴風特想要貢品。它說，只要你獻上貢品，就會給你豐厚的回報。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: So try offering a part of your assets to the Baphomet.
scripts.translation: 所以，不妨拿出一部分財產，獻給巴風特。

scripts.text: The Sandman cries with sadness when money comes up. It is sad because money does not possess love or affection.
scripts.translation: 一提到錢，泥人就傷心地哭了。因為金錢裡沒有愛，也沒有溫情。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: I wonder the meaning of money will slowly disappear from your life as well.
scripts.translation: 不知道金錢在你生活中的意義，會不會也慢慢消失。

scripts.text: The Sandman is screaming because it saw too much money. It saw the money in the hands of your future. I wonder what all that money is?
scripts.translation: 泥人看到了太多的錢，嚇得尖叫。它看到的，是你未來手裡的錢。那究竟是些什麼錢呢？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: I wonder.. Aren't you curious?
scripts.translation: 真讓人好奇...你不好奇嗎？

scripts.text: The Sandman's body is empty inside. Your wallet seems to be emtpy, too. You should save up some money.
scripts.translation: 泥人的身體裡空空如也。你的錢包似乎也一樣。該攢點錢了。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: The Sandman likes to save, too. Even a monster likes to save, but when a human doesn't...
scripts.translation: 泥人也喜歡存錢。連魔物都懂得存錢，人要是還不存...

scripts.text: Money is like sand. Even you save it, once the wind blows, it disappears. This card shows the emptiness of money.
scripts.translation: 錢就像沙子，攢得再多，風一吹也就散了。這張牌說的，是金錢的虛無。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Indeed, money is futile.
scripts.translation: 的確，金錢終究虛妄。

scripts.text: Sohee is wearing a fine article. To wear something like that, you would need plenty of money. Do you know what the secret is? Sohee saved very much when she was once alive.
scripts.translation: 鬼女穿著精美的衣服，置辦這樣一身可得花不少錢。知道秘訣嗎？她生前攢下了不少積蓄。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: So you should start saving, too.
scripts.translation: 所以，你也該開始存錢了。

scripts.text: Sohee hates misers. She believes she has become like that because of a miser. Don't be stingy in front of Sohee!
scripts.translation: 鬼女討厭吝嗇鬼，因為她覺得，自己就是被一個吝嗇鬼害成這樣的。可別在鬼女面前小氣！

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: That type of stinginess will spite other people. Use money when it is necessary.
scripts.translation: 那麼吝嗇，會惹人怨恨。該花的錢，還是得花。

scripts.text: Sohee dislikes the wealthy. They try to gather money, but never use it for others. you don't want to be cursed by Sohee, you need to learn how to be generous with money.
scripts.translation: 鬼女不喜歡有錢人，他們只顧著攢錢，從不肯為別人花。不想受到鬼女的詛咒，就得學會大方些。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: So you have malicious desires, forget them. An ill heart easily gathers misfortune.
scripts.translation: 所以，若有惡念，就打消吧。心術不正，容易招來災禍。

scripts.text: Sohee likes foreign money. They are cute and pretty. you have foreign currency, Sohee will love you.
scripts.translation: 鬼女喜歡外幣，覺得它們可愛又漂亮。你若有外幣，她就會喜歡你。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Keep an eye out for foreign currency. It will bring you luck.
scripts.translation: 留意外幣，它會給你帶來好運。

scripts.text: Those who work hard will gather great fortune. The Skeleton says diligent work will help greatly in gathering wealth.
scripts.translation: 努力工作的人，會積攢豐厚的財富。邪骸戰士說，勤奮工作對積聚財富大有幫助。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Hmm~ a ghost is saying strange things.
scripts.translation: 嗯~幽靈說的話，真奇怪。

scripts.text: Its youth is gone after a lifetime of chasing after gold. It became a monster with only bones left. No matter how much you like money and your work, look after your life as well.
scripts.translation: 它一輩子追逐黃金，耗盡了青春，變成只剩骨頭的魔物。再喜歡錢和工作，也得照顧好自己的生活。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: There is much more to life than wealth.
scripts.translation: 生活中比財富更重要的東西還有很多。

scripts.text: To become rich, you must work hard as you became a skeleton. The Skeleton is saying to work hard until you become a skeleton.
scripts.translation: 想發財，就得拼命幹，幹到自己只剩一副骨架。邪骸戰士就是讓你一直努力工作，直到變成骷髏。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Then not only the Skeleton, but many people will repay you greatly.
scripts.translation: 這樣，不光邪骸戰士，許多人都會給你豐厚的回報。

scripts.text: The Skeleton says that you can make money by going north. Go north.
scripts.translation: 邪骸戰士說，往北走就能賺錢。去北方吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: There must be great fortune in that direction.
scripts.translation: 那個方向，一定有大好的財運。

scripts.text: A knight is a job that requires a lot of money. A hint of a big expense. You might want to tighten your belt.
scripts.translation: 當騎士很費錢。這預示著一筆大開銷，你恐怕得勒緊褲腰帶。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: That is, you don't want go to bankrupt.
scripts.translation: 當然，前提是你不想破產。

scripts.text: Knights do not fight for money. they did, they would be a mercenary. A knight reaches for something higher. What the knight wants to tell you is the way to live.
scripts.translation: 騎士不為錢而戰，否則就成了傭兵。他們追求更高的目標。騎士想告訴你的，是該如何生活。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Set a goal higher than money and wealth. Do you understand, young one?
scripts.translation: 把目標定得比金錢和財富更高些。年輕人，明白了嗎？

scripts.text: A knight values honor more than fortune. They consider discussing wealth itself dirty not worthy. How would you be able to ask such a knight a fortune about wealth?
scripts.translation: 騎士看重榮譽，勝過財富，甚至認為談錢都骯髒、不值一提。你怎麼能向這樣的騎士詢問財運呢？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: The knight says that a new road of life will open once you look away from fortune.
scripts.translation: 騎士說，不再只盯著財富，人生就會出現一條新的路。

scripts.text: You need to think of an ideal more noble than money. The fortune the knight suggests is this: Knights never speak of ways to make money.
scripts.translation: 你該想想比金錢更高尚的理想。騎士給你的指引就是：騎士從不談賺錢的辦法。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Compared to life, they believe money is foolish. The knight would like to understand these ideas of life.
scripts.translation: 在他們看來，和生命相比，金錢不過是愚蠢的東西。騎士想理解這些關於生命的道理。

scripts.text: Working hard is the only way to gather wealth; don't get sidetracked and put effort into working will help your fortune.
scripts.translation: 積聚財富，唯有努力工作。別分心，把精力放在工作上，財運才會好。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: So do your best.
scripts.translation: 所以，盡力去做吧。

scripts.text: What does the god of death have to say about wealth? It is surely a bad omen. It is trying to warn something.
scripts.translation: 死神對財富能有什麼話說呢？這肯定不是好兆頭。它正在警告你什麼。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Be careful. It is the word of the god of death.
scripts.translation: 多加小心。這可是死神的話。

scripts.text: The Anubis is very interested in the sacrifices offered. The offerings he likes are youth and effort.
scripts.translation: 安畢斯對獻上的祭品很感興趣。它喜歡的祭品，是青春和努力。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: you offer these two things, the Anubis says he will bring you wealth.
scripts.translation: 安畢斯說，只要獻上這兩樣東西，它就會給你帶來財富。

scripts.text: The Anubis is giving a warning of the west. There is a being there that can break away your wealth.
scripts.translation: 安畢斯警告你，當心西方。那裡有個東西，能奪走你的財富。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: you want to protect your assets, beware of the west.
scripts.translation: 想守住財產，就得提防西方。

scripts.text: The Anubis hates those who try to gather money for his death. He believes it's a waste of money. Don't make the mistake of gathering money for death.
scripts.translation: 安畢斯討厭那些為自己的死亡攢錢的人，覺得這純粹是浪費。可別犯下為死亡攢錢的錯誤。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: This is the true advice of a Anubis.
scripts.translation: 這才是安畢斯真正的忠告。

scripts.text: The Orc Lord possesses much wealth. It's because of greed. Greed is essential in collecting money. The desire and greediness to make money is not something to be ashamed about. Be diligent and go make money.
scripts.translation: 獸人酋長有很多財富，因為它貪心。想積攢錢財，貪心是少不了的。想賺錢、有貪念，並不是什麼可恥的事。勤勤懇懇地賺錢去吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: But, too much greed is forbidden.
scripts.translation: 不過，可不能貪得無厭。

scripts.text: The Orc Lord starts drooling about anything involving money. He targets anybody with money.
scripts.translation: 獸人酋長一提到錢就流口水。他會盯上任何有錢的人。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Therefore, don't speak of money to the Orc Lord.
scripts.translation: 所以，別在獸人酋長面前談錢。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Same goes for humans. Be wary of those who are avaricious like the Orc Lord.
scripts.translation: 人也一樣。要提防那些像獸人酋長一樣貪婪的人。

scripts.text: There should be great wealth awaiting in the direction the Orc Lord's horn is pointing. The card is directing towards..
scripts.translation: 獸人酋長的角指向哪裡，哪裡就有豐厚的財富等著你。卡牌指向的是...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: The northwest? Would you like to try your luck in that direction?
scripts.translation: 西北方？要不要去那邊碰碰運氣？

scripts.text: The Orc Lord likes gold. Of all the treasures, gold is the best. Closely watch gold.
scripts.translation: 獸人酋長喜歡黃金。在所有寶物裡，它覺得黃金最好。多留意黃金吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Gold is rather peculiar compared to other assets.
scripts.translation: 和其他財產相比，黃金有些特別。

scripts.text: Jack makes money through jokes. Others' happiness is the key to his wealth.
scripts.translation: 裘卡靠講笑話賺錢。讓別人快樂，就是它致富的秘訣。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Why don't you learn how to make others happy? It should be of great help.
scripts.translation: 不妨學學怎樣讓別人開心？這應該會大有幫助。

scripts.text: Jack likes fun money. He detests sad and burdensome money.
scripts.translation: 裘卡喜歡賺得開心的錢，討厭讓人悲傷、背上負擔的錢。

scripts.text: He always says this. Light-hearted and easy money isn't dangerous even it piles up.
scripts.translation: 它總說，賺得輕鬆愉快的錢，堆得再多也不危險。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: As Jack's advice says, stay closer to light money. It is safer and better.
scripts.translation: 聽裘卡的建議，去賺那些輕鬆愉快的錢吧。這樣更安全，也更好。

scripts.text: Jack thinks of money as a foolish item. But somehow he makes that kind of money.
scripts.translation: 裘卡覺得錢是愚蠢的東西，可不知怎麼，偏偏又賺到了錢。

scripts.text: That's why those who are controlled by fools consider the other a fool, too.
scripts.translation: 所以，被傻瓜支配的人，也會把對方看成傻瓜。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: you don't want to be considered a fool by Jack, don't be controlled by money.
scripts.translation: 不想被裘卡當成傻瓜，就別受金錢擺佈。

scripts.text: Or else, Jack will attack.
scripts.translation: 否則，它會發起攻擊。

scripts.text: Jack is asking for money. Don't be stingy about paying those who bring entertainment and fun.
scripts.translation: 裘卡在要錢。對那些帶來歡樂的人，可別吝嗇報酬。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Then, Jack will reward you in return.
scripts.translation: 這樣，裘卡就會給你回報。

scripts.text: Do you know what a joker's specialty is? It is tricking others and making money. Be wary of the joker.
scripts.translation: 知道裘卡最擅長什麼嗎？騙別人，從中賺錢。可得提防它。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Jokers do not exist in one form. They will aim for your money in several different ways.
scripts.translation: 裘卡不只有一種模樣。它們會用各種辦法，打你錢財的主意。

scripts.text: The Joker says you let him borrow money, he will repay you with more. You're going to refuse, right? But the Joker's temptation does not end after one try.
scripts.translation: 裘卡說，只要借錢給它，就會還你更多。你會拒絕，對吧？可它的誘惑不會到此為止。

scripts.text: He will linger around you as a neighbor, or a rare item and ask for money.
scripts.translation: 它會以鄰居或稀有物品的模樣，在你身邊打轉，繼續向你要錢。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Act wisely! You'll be in trouble you are tricked easily!
scripts.translation: 行事要聰明些！輕易上當，可會惹上麻煩！

scripts.text: Even a joker asks for change, never give any to him. He will ask for change, then end up ask for a big sum of money.
scripts.translation: 裘卡就算只要一點零錢，也千萬別給。它會先要零錢，再要一大筆錢。

scripts.text: Jokers are like that. They have the ability to turn a small mistake into a big calamity.
scripts.translation: 裘卡就是這樣，能把一點小失誤變成一場大災禍。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: That's why you should be more careful about it.
scripts.translation: 所以，你更得小心。

scripts.text: There is only one reason a Joker requests money.. to take yours.
scripts.translation: 裘卡要錢，只有一個目的...拿走你的錢。

scripts.text: His goal is not to become rich. A real foul playful one.
scripts.translation: 它並不是想發財，只是個惡劣的搗蛋鬼。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: But losing money isn't a joke now, is it? You should be careful.
scripts.translation: 不過，丟錢可不是鬧著玩的，對吧？你得小心。

scripts.text: Hodes do not know about money. They just gobble everything up. But that might be the shortcut to gaining great wealth.
scripts.translation: 蚯蚓不懂錢，只知道把一切都吞下去。不過，這也許反倒是積聚大量財富的捷徑。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Don't focus too much on money. Just work at it. It's saying that it is the best method.
scripts.translation: 別總盯著錢，踏實幹活就好。卡牌說，這才是最好的辦法。

scripts.text: Hodes do not know anything about money. But they do not forgive those who have an eye on their things.
scripts.translation: 蚯蚓對錢一無所知，卻絕不放過覬覦自己東西的人。

scripts.text: Not being greedy and taking care of your share is the wisest way to manage your wealth.
scripts.translation: 不貪心，守好自己那一份，才是最明智的理財之道。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Indeed, the Hode is right. Do you understand as well?
scripts.translation: 的確，蚯蚓說得對。你也明白了嗎？

scripts.text: The Hode knows nothing about money. But a very rare item drops from a Hode's body.
scripts.translation: 蚯蚓不懂錢，身上卻會掉落十分稀有的物品。

scripts.text: It has a treasure in it without knowing.
scripts.translation: 它肚子裡藏著寶物，自己還不知道。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Take a careful look around you. Treasures are hidden all over.
scripts.translation: 仔細看看四周吧。寶物藏得到處都是。

scripts.text: Hodes are strong even though they live in the desert. Just because the environment is poor, doesn't mean that you can't gather wealth.
scripts.translation: 蚯蚓住在沙漠裡，卻依然強壯。環境不好，不代表就沒法積聚財富。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Don't blame the environment. That excuse is only for whiners.
scripts.translation: 別怪環境不好。那只是愛抱怨的人找的藉口。

scripts.text: Do you know the saying that says those who work like bulls become rich? Working hard is the best way.
scripts.translation: 聽過“像牛一樣幹活，就能發財”這句話嗎？努力工作，才是最好的辦法。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Just like a bull.
scripts.translation: 就像公牛一樣。

scripts.text: Bulls only know how to work, but the bull itself has a lot to offer. Meat, leather, horn..
scripts.translation: 牛隻知道幹活，可它自身也能提供不少東西。肉、皮革、角...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You, too, should look after yourself and not just work. You have many hidden values.
scripts.translation: 你也得照顧自己，別隻顧著幹活。你身上還有很多未被發現的價值。

scripts.text: Bulls continue to work even on gloomy days. Then they can gather a lot of things.
scripts.translation: 即使日子陰沉，牛也不停幹活。這樣，就能積攢不少東西。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Don't be picky about the days you work. You will be able to make more money.
scripts.translation: 別挑日子幹活。這樣，你才能賺到更多錢。

scripts.text: Bulls do not like working for money. They are disgruntled when others consider labor as money.
scripts.translation: 牛不喜歡只為錢幹活，也不滿別人把勞動全看成金錢。

scripts.text: Shouldn't you reconsider working against your will just for money?
scripts.translation: 如果你為了錢，做著違背心意的工作，是不是該重新想一想？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: It is a serious problem. It is your life, so ponder about it young one.
scripts.translation: 這是個嚴肅的問題。年輕人，這是你自己的人生，要好好想想。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Most people are curious about money.
scripts.translation: 大多數人都想知道自己的財運，這很平常，也是人之常情。

scripts.text: It is a very humanly and common curiosity. Cards are very stingy about fortunes regarding wealth.
scripts.translation: 可卡牌對財運方面的預言，總是很吝嗇。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Therefore, getting a fortune like this is considered being lucky. Use this fortune to prosper.
scripts.translation: 所以，能得到這樣的預言，已經算幸運了。藉著這份運勢，讓日子興旺起來吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Future... the card that sees the future is beginning to speak...... Prepare yourself...
scripts.translation: 未來...預見未來的卡牌，開始說話了...做好準備...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Youth is not eternal. At one point when you wake up, you realize you are already a middle-aged worker.
scripts.translation: 青春不會永遠停留。某天醒來，你會發現自己已經成了中年工人。

scripts.text: Even reminiscing about the past over a cup of coffee can't bring back time.
scripts.translation: 即使喝著咖啡回憶從前，也喚不回逝去的時光。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Treasure the present.. is what the card is saying.
scripts.translation: 珍惜當下...這就是卡牌想說的。

scripts.text: This fortune is foreshadowing that you will become a strong and healthy worker in the future.
scripts.translation: 這次占卜預示，你將來會成為一個強壯健康的工人。

scripts.text: Not a normal worker, but one that has great strength and might..
scripts.translation: 不是普通工人，而是力大無比的人...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You should prepare for your future.
scripts.translation: 你該為未來做好準備。

scripts.text: Smoking in a mine is an imprudent, life-threatening thing to do. You are wasting your precious life with that kind of behavior.
scripts.translation: 在礦井裡抽菸，是莽撞又危及生命的行為。這麼做，是在糟蹋自己寶貴的生命。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Act with a little more wisdom for your future.
scripts.translation: 為了未來，行事要更明智些。

scripts.text: You may be shoveling in the future. In a dark dark place, shoveling that requires great strength. You must be careful young one.
scripts.translation: 你將來可能要鏟土。在漆黑的地方，做著很費力氣的鏟土活。年輕人，多加小心。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: This type of fortune is never wrong.
scripts.translation: 這樣的預言，從不會錯。

scripts.text: The moth is used when it is a caterpillar and ignored after it becomes a moth, by humans.
scripts.translation: 人類會利用尚是毛毛蟲的它，卻在它變成飛蛾後不再理會。

scripts.text: Which is better?
scripts.translation: 哪一種更好呢？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Check to see if there is an aspect of your life that is like the moth.
scripts.translation: 想想看，你的生活裡，有沒有哪一面像這隻飛蛾？

scripts.text: The moth flies around without worrying about the future. It is telling you to fly freely rather than getting anxious about the future..
scripts.translation: 飛蛾四處飛舞，從不為未來發愁。它告訴你，與其擔憂未來，不如自在飛翔...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: This is the fortune from this card.
scripts.translation: 這就是這張牌給出的預言。

scripts.text: Dustiness' teeth are very strong. This means...
scripts.translation: 獵蠅的牙齒很堅硬。這意味著...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: To live the future with strong teeth?!
scripts.translation: 靠堅硬的牙齒，活出未來？！

scripts.text: The moth says that this is not a time to think about wealth and prosperity. It says that someone important has appeared near you.
scripts.translation: 飛蛾說，現在不是考慮財富與興旺的時候。你的身邊，已經出現了一位重要的人。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Any ideas who that may be?
scripts.translation: 想到那可能是誰了嗎？

scripts.text: Dustiness symbolizes a hazy future. It is similar to your mind right now. It says it is obvious.
scripts.translation: 獵蠅象徵著模糊的未來，就像你此刻的心境。它說，這是再自然不過的。

scripts.text: It says that there is no set path in the future. Isn't a relief in a way?
scripts.translation: 未來沒有一條註定的路，換個角度想，不也讓人鬆了口氣嗎？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: It is not good nor bad, so there is always room for new possibilities.
scripts.translation: 這無所謂好壞，所以總有新的可能。

scripts.text: Sometime in your future, a future like Dracula awaits you.
scripts.translation: 在未來的某個時候，德古拉般的命運正等著你。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: If you hope for that type of future, it is no problem, but you should be careful nonetheless.
scripts.translation: 如果你想要的就是那樣的未來，倒也沒什麼。不過，還是得小心。

scripts.text: If the condition is just right, vampires can live forever. But, when that perfect condition is disrupted, they meet a tragic end.
scripts.translation: 條件恰到好處，吸血鬼就能永生。可一旦這種完美的條件被打破，它們就會迎來悲慘的結局。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: This means that if you go after fame and eternal life, tragedy awaits you in the end. They are not the important things in life.
scripts.translation: 這說明，若一味追求名聲和永生，最後等著你的就是悲劇。那些並不是人生中最重要的事。

scripts.text: The Dracula says to be true to the present. Indeed, thinking and being true to the present is much more important than trying to figure out your future.
scripts.translation: 德古拉說，要認真活在當下。的確，比起猜測未來，思考當下、認真過好現在，更重要。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Unfortunately, I agree with it young one.
scripts.translation: 年輕人，很遺憾，我也贊同它。

scripts.text: Pirates do not have a future. That doesn't mean you do not have one. But.. you simply need to make more prudent decisions.
scripts.translation: 海盜沒有未來，可這不代表你也沒有。不過...你得更謹慎地作決定。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: How about changing your lifestyle? That's what this means.
scripts.translation: 不妨改變一下生活方式？這就是它的意思。

scripts.text: In this world, being a pirate out in the rough seas is very dangerous. But, they do not regret their decisions.
scripts.translation: 在這個世界上，出海闖蕩洶湧的大海，當個海盜，非常危險。可他們並不後悔自己的選擇。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Because they find their meaning of life in the process. Young one, how about searching for the meaning of your life?
scripts.translation: 因為他們在這過程中，找到了人生的意義。年輕人，你也去找找自己人生的意義，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Pirates are remembered as pirates even after they pass away. A person's name is beyond the matter of life and death.
scripts.translation: 海盜即使死了，也依然會以海盜之名被記住。一個人的名字，是能超越生死的。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You should live with that aspect in mind.
scripts.translation: 生活時，要把這一點記在心裡。

scripts.text: The Marina does not think of its future.. But I can tell you one thing. Survival. The Marina only thinks about survival and life.
scripts.translation: 水母不考慮未來...可我能告訴你一件事：生存。它只想著活下去。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You.. no, all of us should learn and do the same.
scripts.translation: 你...不，是我們所有人，都該學習，並照著去做。

scripts.text: The Marina doesn't think of its future.. but I can tell you one thing. Freedom. The Marina swims freely.
scripts.translation: 水母不考慮未來...可我能告訴你一件事：自由。它總是自在地遊動。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: How about living like that, too?
scripts.translation: 你也試著這樣生活，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Leave your future to the Marina. The Marina treasures its precious ocean. The sea will be of great significance in your future, too.
scripts.translation: 把你的未來交給水母吧。它珍愛自己的海洋。大海在你的未來，也會有重要的意義。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: A fisherman? Oceanographer? Pirate? Although I do not know which job it is...
scripts.translation: 漁夫？海洋學家？海盜？雖然我也不知道，究竟是哪種職業...

scripts.text: A Marionette is a Marionette forever. Its past and future never changes. Its present is its future. Don't you think it is rather sad?
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃永遠是傀儡娃娃，過去和未來都不會變。現在是什麼樣，將來就是什麼樣。你不覺得有些悲哀嗎？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: But that could also be a good thing. This is the meaning of a Marionette.
scripts.translation: 不過，這也可能是件好事。這就是傀儡娃娃的意思。

scripts.text: A Marionette is restrained but it has hope that it will be freed one day.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃雖然被束縛著，卻仍盼著有一天能獲得自由。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Very nice. This fortune signifies 'hope'.
scripts.translation: 很好。這次占卜象徵著“希望”。

scripts.text: The eyes of a Marionette symbolize 'challenge.' Challenge will mean a lot in your future.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃的眼睛，象徵著“挑戰”。挑戰在你的未來，會有重要的意義。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: ...to the point where that challenge will change your life.
scripts.translation: ...那場挑戰，甚至會改變你的人生。

scripts.text: The Marionette believes the present is more important than the future. Basically, asking about the future is pointless.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃覺得，現在比未來更重要。說到底，詢問未來並沒有什麼意義。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: The Marionette devotes everything into the present. It suggests that type of attitude to you, too.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃把一切都投入當下。它也建議你抱著這樣的態度。

scripts.text: The Medusa symbolizes the absolute one who accepts everyone's challenge. Your future will be in a position that is challenged by many.
scripts.translation: 米杜沙象徵著接受一切挑戰的絕對強者。將來，你會站在一個遭到許多人挑戰的位置。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: It could be good and bad. It is also a very tiring position.
scripts.translation: 這有好有壞，也是個很累人的位置。

scripts.text: The Medusa symbolizes the absolute one who accepts everyone's challenge. Your future must be filled with challenges!
scripts.translation: 米杜沙象徵著接受一切挑戰的絕對強者。你的未來，一定會充滿挑戰！

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Always challenge others! It is alright to fail, since challenge itself will become life.
scripts.translation: 不斷去挑戰別人吧！失敗也沒關係，因為挑戰本身，就是人生。

scripts.text: The Medusa says that there will be great chaos in the future. Chaos... I'm not sure what type of chaos it means, but it is definitely something that has never happened before.
scripts.translation: 米杜沙說，未來會有一場大混亂。混亂...我也不清楚是什麼樣的混亂，但一定是前所未有的事。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: There is something that you must fight.. and win, in your future.
scripts.translation: 在你的未來，有件事必須去抗爭...而且必須獲勝。

scripts.text: The hair of the Medusa are sticking up. It is nervous about the big change that is going to happen. A change that even makes the scary Medusa worried.
scripts.translation: 米杜沙的頭髮都豎起來了。即將發生的大變化，讓它很緊張。那可是連可怕的米杜沙都會擔憂的變化。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: How about preparing yourself as well?
scripts.translation: 你也做好準備，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: The Baphomet doesn't care about a human's future. They simply observe quietly. Hmm... It seems like it has nothing to say about your future as well...
scripts.translation: 巴風特不在意人類的未來，只是靜靜地看著。嗯...看來，它對你的未來也沒什麼可說的...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: It has an unconcerned expression.
scripts.translation: 它一臉毫不在意的樣子。

scripts.text: The scythe the Baphomet is holding signifies the strong will to conquer the future.
scripts.translation: 巴風特手中的鐮刀，象徵著征服未來的堅定意志。

scripts.text: What you need is not someone else's help or wisdom, but strong willpower.
scripts.translation: 你需要的，不是別人的幫助或智慧，而是強大的意志力。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Once you have that type of willpower, the road to the future will be very broad and promising.
scripts.translation: 有了這樣的意志力，通往未來的路就會寬廣而充滿希望。

scripts.text: The Baphomet says that humans have no future. It says that their greed and selfishness shows no hope.
scripts.translation: 巴風特說，人類沒有未來，因為貪婪和自私，讓它看不到任何希望。

scripts.text: The future will only open to those that go beyond human's greed.
scripts.translation: 只有擺脫人類貪慾的人，未來才會向他們敞開。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: The card expects something like that from you.
scripts.translation: 卡牌期待你做到這一點。

scripts.text: The Baphomet is facing the future. No matter how much effort you put in, without an eye that looks towards the future, it is pointless.
scripts.translation: 巴風特面向未來。無論多努力，若沒有著眼未來的目光，也只是白費力氣。

scripts.text: The Baphomet is telling you to look towards the future.
scripts.translation: 它在告訴你，要看向未來。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: To know your position right now and where to aim in the future.
scripts.translation: 認清自己現在的位置，也看清未來該朝哪個方向努力。

scripts.text: A sand's future is simply sand. Not a rock, nor mud. Some things just don't change young one.
scripts.translation: 沙子將來依然是沙子，不會變成岩石，也不會變成泥。年輕人，有些東西就是不會變。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: What the Sandman card is trying to say is to treasure your present self.
scripts.translation: 泥人牌想說的是，珍惜現在的自己。

scripts.text: A sand dune changes its shape even after a day. The Sandman card is speaking of a future with many changes.
scripts.translation: 沙丘的形狀，哪怕只過一天也會改變。泥人牌預示的，是一個變化不斷的未來。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: It says not to be too caught up with the present, because the future is always changing.
scripts.translation: 它說，別被眼前困住，因為未來總在變化。

scripts.text: You will have a son in the future. Hmm? What'd you say? No plans for a baby?
scripts.translation: 你將來會有個兒子。嗯？你說什麼？沒打算要孩子？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: That's why it is the future. Unexpected things happen every once in a while in the future. Lala~
scripts.translation: 所以才叫未來呀。未來總會時不時冒出意想不到的事。啦啦~

scripts.text: There are rare and precious treasures in the sand. The Sandman says that in the vast sand of the world, a treasure, will be discovered. That treasure is you young one.
scripts.translation: 沙裡藏著稀有而珍貴的寶物。泥人說，在這世界無邊的沙海里，會有一件寶物被發現。年輕人，那件寶物就是你。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Hmm... Expecting a lot. Hehe~
scripts.translation: 嗯...真讓人期待。呵呵~

scripts.text: Do you know what a Sohee thinks the most pitiful thing is? The future. It is because she was not able to live her future.
scripts.translation: 知道鬼女覺得最悲哀的是什麼嗎？是未來，因為她沒能活到自己的未來。

scripts.text: That is why you cannot bring up the subject of future in front of Sohee. I'm very sorry I cannot help.
scripts.translation: 所以，在鬼女面前不能提未來。很抱歉，我也幫不上忙。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: But isn't it better than a curse. Just think of it as that and forget about it.
scripts.translation: 不過，總比詛咒好吧。這麼想想，然後忘掉就好了。

scripts.text: Even in darkness you will shine for your goal.
scripts.translation: 即使身在黑暗，你也會為目標發光。

scripts.text: The Skeleton is encouraging you to not lose your light even in a life in dark and damp places.
scripts.translation: 邪骸戰士在鼓勵你：哪怕生活在陰暗潮溼的地方，也別失去自己的光芒。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You must feel good, getting a word of encouragement from the Skeleton. Lala~
scripts.translation: 得到邪骸戰士的鼓勵，你一定很高興吧。啦啦~

scripts.text: The story I heard from the skeleton goes like this. I am the king of the future. What in the world is that supposed to mean?
scripts.translation: 邪骸戰士告訴我：“我是未來的國王。”這到底是什麼意思呢？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: I don't know. Maybe it is saying that a scrawny person will do something great in the future?
scripts.translation: 我也不懂。也許，它是說，一個瘦弱的人，將來會有大成就？

scripts.text: If you want to do something great in the future, you must express your thankfulness to the Skeleton.
scripts.translation: 想在將來有所成就，就得向邪骸戰士表達謝意。

scripts.text: Then the Skeleton will help you. How do you express your thankfulness?
scripts.translation: 這樣，它就會幫你。怎麼表達謝意呢？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: If you see someone that resembles the Skeleton, help them.
scripts.translation: 碰到長得像邪骸戰士的人，就幫幫對方吧。

scripts.text: Then the Skeleton will think that you helped itself and be happy. What a silly monster. Haha.
scripts.translation: 這樣，邪骸戰士會以為你幫了它，感到很高興。真是個傻魔物，哈哈。

scripts.text: The Skeleton has the ability to dig where it feels the future, rather than looking into it.
scripts.translation: 邪骸戰士不會窺視未來，卻能感知未來在哪裡，再去挖掘。

scripts.text: It is digging in the east right now. How about it, won't you try going there?
scripts.translation: 它現在正往東邊挖。怎麼樣，要不要去那邊試試？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Who knows, the key to the future may be lying in the east.
scripts.translation: 誰知道呢，通往未來的鑰匙也許就在東方。

scripts.text: A knight's future leads to death. An honorable death on the battlefield.
scripts.translation: 騎士的未來，是死亡，是在戰場上光榮地戰死。

scripts.text: One cannot live as a knight without being proud of that type of future.
scripts.translation: 不能為這樣的未來感到自豪，就無法以騎士的身份活下去。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: The knight wants you to be proud of yourself.
scripts.translation: 騎士希望你為自己感到自豪。

scripts.text: It says what you need is pride. Not honor, wealth, or love.. but pride.
scripts.translation: 它說，你需要的不是榮譽、財富或愛情...而是自豪。

scripts.text: A knight commenting about a person's future is very rare.
scripts.translation: 騎士很少談論一個人的未來。對你，

scripts.text: It says nothing for you in particular. Nothing ominous.
scripts.translation: 它也沒什麼特別要說的。沒有不祥的兆頭。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: It is a very good thing. Means a bright and clear future. Hohoho~
scripts.translation: 這可是好事，意味著光明而清晰的未來。呵呵呵~

scripts.text: A knight commenting about a person's future is very rare.
scripts.translation: 騎士很少談論一個人的未來。對你，

scripts.text: It says it will say one thing for you. Dark clouds can be seen beyond the clear skies.
scripts.translation: 騎士很少談論一個人的未來。不過，它願意對你說一句：晴空之外，隱約可見烏雲。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: You must find out for yourself what those clouds mean. Anyways, you must be careful.
scripts.translation: 那些雲意味著什麼，得由你自己去弄清楚。總之，要小心。

scripts.text: It is necessary to reflect upon the past and present in order to look into the future. This card says to look carefully into your past.
scripts.translation: 想看清未來，得先反思過去和現在。這張牌提醒你，好好審視自己的過去。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: ..with the attitude of reflecting upon yourself. What do you think? Don't you think you lived too much looking into the future?
scripts.translation: ...抱著反省自己的態度。你覺得呢？是不是一直以來，目光都太放在未來了？

scripts.text: What does the god of death want to say about the future? It is definitely an ominous sign.
scripts.translation: 死神對未來能有什麼話說呢？這肯定是個不祥的兆頭。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: It is trying to warn something about the future. Be careful.
scripts.translation: 它正對未來的某件事發出警告。多加小心。

scripts.text: The Anubis likes comedy despite people's expectations. It looks forward to comedy. Comedy must be important in the future.
scripts.translation: 出人意料，安畢斯喜歡喜劇，還很期待。看來，喜劇在未來會很重要。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: In your case, it would be wise to grow your sense of humor.
scripts.translation: 對你來說，培養些幽默感是個明智的選擇。

scripts.text: The Anubis is the god of death, but it expresses more interest in the future than death.
scripts.translation: 安畢斯雖是死神，對未來卻比對死亡更感興趣。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Even the Anubis doesn't think about death, so why should you be thinking about it? Expect a good future young one.
scripts.translation: 連安畢斯都不想死亡，你又何必去想？年輕人，期待美好的未來吧。

scripts.text: The Anubis says it has no interest in you. It is a good sign.
scripts.translation: 安畢斯說，它對你沒興趣。這是個好兆頭。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: What can be better than being ignored by the god of death?
scripts.translation: 還有什麼比死神不理你，更值得高興的呢？

scripts.text: The Orc Lord says that dairy farming will develop in the future. Why don't you invest in it as well?
scripts.translation: 獸人酋長說，未來奶牛養殖業會興旺起來。你要不要也投資一下？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: A business looking into the future?
scripts.translation: 一門著眼未來的生意？

scripts.text: The Orc Lord says you need great strength in the future. Strength that is three, four times greater than now.
scripts.translation: 獸人酋長說，你將來需要強大的力量。得有現在的三四倍。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Make yourself stronger in any form. In the future, you will need it.
scripts.translation: 不管用什麼方式，都要讓自己更強。將來，你會需要這份力量。

scripts.text: The Orc Lord says that love for your companions will become great strength in the future.
scripts.translation: 獸人酋長說，對同伴的愛，會在未來成為強大的力量。

scripts.text: Your strength is not enough.
scripts.translation: 單靠你自己的力量，還不夠。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: To become a Lord, you will need colleagues. You should take the Orc Lord's advice!
scripts.translation: 想成為領主，就得有夥伴。聽聽獸人酋長的建議吧！

scripts.text: The Orc Lord is expressing opposition in being too curious about the future.
scripts.translation: 獸人酋長不贊成對未來太過好奇。

scripts.text: Pay a little more attention to the present.
scripts.translation: 多關心一下當下吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Respect his opinion young one. You have nothing to lose.
scripts.translation: 年輕人，尊重它的意見吧。你也不會有什麼損失。

scripts.text: Jack says something interesting will happen in the future. According to him, the future will be more fun than the present.
scripts.translation: 裘卡說，將來會發生有趣的事。在它看來，未來會比現在更好玩。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Are you looking forward to it?
scripts.translation: 你期待嗎？

scripts.text: Jack says, in order to prepare for the future, a delightful preparation is necessary.
scripts.translation: 裘卡說，為未來做準備，也得準備得開心。開心的準備？

scripts.text: Delightful preparation? I don't understand.. I suppose I am too old. Maybe young ones get it..
scripts.translation: 我不懂...大概是年紀太大了，也許年輕人能明白...

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: What do you think? Any assumptions?
