scripts.translation: 你怎麼看？猜到什麼了嗎？

scripts.text: Jack is jealous because a splendid person is headed your way in the future.
scripts.translation: 將來會有一位出色的人來到你身邊，裘卡都嫉妒了。

scripts.text: I wonder what type of person it is to make that Jack jealous!
scripts.translation: 到底是什麼樣的人，能讓裘卡嫉妒呢！

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: One thing for sure is that you will be very happy! Congratulations young one!
scripts.translation: 有一點可以肯定：你會很幸福！恭喜呀，年輕人！

scripts.text: Jack says you may be frustrated in the future.
scripts.translation: 裘卡說，你將來可能會感到挫敗。

scripts.text: He says to overcome the frustration, it is necessary to think of happy thoughts.
scripts.translation: 想擺脫這種心情，就要多想想開心的事。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Meaning your future will become a battle between happiness and frustration..
scripts.translation: 也就是說，你的未來會是幸福與挫敗之間的一場較量...

scripts.text: The Joker is trying to trick you. This card has all different types of ominous fortunes.
scripts.translation: 裘卡想捉弄你。這張牌裡，全是各種不祥的預言。

scripts.text: He wants to enjoy watching you tremble with anxiety.
scripts.translation: 它就是想看你擔心得發抖，拿來取樂。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Sadness, failure, darkness, loneliness.. you may feel all of these emotions, but they are not fatal. Don't worry.
scripts.translation: 悲傷、失敗、黑暗、孤獨...這些感受，你可能都會經歷。不過，它們並不致命，別擔心。

scripts.text: Jokers don't just appear and go away. They come back in the future.
scripts.translation: 裘卡不會現身一次就此消失，將來還會回來。

scripts.text: They will seduce you numerous times.
scripts.translation: 它們會一次又一次地誘惑你。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: So train yourself not to be tempted.
scripts.translation: 所以，要鍛鍊自己，不受誘惑。

scripts.text: Or else you will face frustration or commit a blunder.
scripts.translation: 否則，你會遭到挫敗，或犯下大錯。

scripts.text: Do you see the thing that looks like a leaf flying around the Joker? That is the spade mark.
scripts.translation: 看見裘卡身邊那些像葉子一樣飄動的東西了嗎？那是黑桃符號。

scripts.text: Spades means death. Jokers leave those kinds of marks on purpose.
scripts.translation: 黑桃意味著死亡，裘卡是故意留下這些符號的。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Don't get disturbed by the mark of death. It's merely a Joker's joke.
scripts.translation: 別被死亡的符號攪得心神不寧。那只是裘卡的玩笑。

scripts.text: Joker offers a nice insurance and says to prepare for the future, but most of it is a waste of time.
scripts.translation: 裘卡會推薦一份看似不錯的保險，說是要為未來做準備。可大多隻是白費時間。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Don't prepare for the future carelessly. A loose measure is worse than a prepared adventure.
scripts.translation: 別草率地為未來做準備。敷衍的應對，還不如一次準備充分的冒險。

scripts.text: Hodes do not know about tomorrow. But though they are quiet, they endanger other living things.
scripts.translation: 蚯蚓不懂明天。可它們雖不聲不響，卻能威脅其他生物。

scripts.text: Effort into oneself puts great power into the mere existence of one.
scripts.translation: 努力提升自己，哪怕只是存在，也能有強大的力量。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Don't forget that you must think about yorsrelf the most.
scripts.translation: 別忘了，最該多想想的，是你自己。

scripts.text: Hodes do not know about tomorrow, but they still know about death.
scripts.translation: 蚯蚓不懂明天，卻知道死亡。

scripts.text: Even though you may be honest and simple, in a time of a crisis, you must be alert.
scripts.translation: 你即使老實單純，遇到危機，也得保持警惕。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Or else you will really be a simple and honest fool. That may be troublesome.
scripts.translation: 否則，你可真要成個單純老實的傻瓜了。那會惹麻煩的。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Hodes do not ponder about life, but their will to live is very strong.
scripts.translation: 蚯蚓不思考人生，求生的意志卻很強。

scripts.text: You can gain a lot simply through the will to hold on to life.
scripts.translation: 光是堅持活下去的意志，就能讓你收穫很多。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Be thankful that you are alive. Thankfullness itself should help greatly.
scripts.translation: 為自己還活著而心懷感激吧。這份感激本身，就會給你很大的幫助。

scripts.text: Hodes are afraid of crises. You should try not to be afraid of crises either.
scripts.translation: 蚯蚓害怕危機。你也該試著不去害怕危機。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Don't think of them too much. A crisis is simply a crisis.
scripts.translation: 別為那些事想得太多。危機終究只是危機。

scripts.text: Before, bulls used to be thought of as foolishly honest workers, but these days bulls are great strong fighters.
scripts.translation: 從前，牛被當成憨厚老實的勞動者。可如今，牛也是強大的戰士。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Finding different sides of oneself is the way to improve. Study about yourself.
scripts.translation: 發現自己不同的一面，才能進步。多瞭解自己吧。

scripts.text: Do bulls leave leather when they pass away? Or was it the tiger?
scripts.translation: 牛死後會留下皮嗎？還是說，那是老虎？

scripts.text: Anyways, he is jealous of the humans that leave their name in history.
scripts.translation: 總之，它很羨慕那些能在歷史上留下名字的人。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: If you don't leave your name, he may bear hatred against you for wasting your life.
scripts.translation: 要是沒能留下名字，它可能會因為你虛度人生而怨恨你。

scripts.text: So, to not be cursed, make an effort to leave your name in history.
scripts.translation: 所以，不想被詛咒，就努力在歷史上留下名字吧。

scripts.text: It might seem funny that a bull will look into the future, but the bull is looking into your future right now.
scripts.translation: 牛能看見未來，聽著也許可笑，可它現在確實正看著你的未來。

scripts.text: He says your future is mixed with storms and fall weather.
scripts.translation: 它說，你的未來既有風暴，也有秋日的天氣。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: It may be difficult if you are caught up with one situation. In good times, prepare for the bad, and in bad times look forward to good luck.
scripts.translation: 只顧著眼前一種境況，可能會很難應對變化。順境時，為逆境做準備；逆境時，期待好運。

scripts.text: The bull thinks of the happiness awaiting in the future, but it doesn't like reduced efficiency because of that happiness.
scripts.translation: 牛也想著未來的幸福，可不喜歡因為憧憬幸福，就耽誤了幹活。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Even though happiness may be on its way, don't let it affect your work right now.
scripts.translation: 即使幸福已經在路上，也別讓它耽誤了眼前的工作。

scripts.text: This is the bull's thought and your fortune.
scripts.translation: 這就是牛的想法，也是給你的預言。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Speaking of the future is as dangerous act.
scripts.translation: 談論未來，是件危險的事。

scripts.text: Humans may face disaster if speaking of the future carelessly. That's why we ask cards about the future.
scripts.translation: 人若隨意談論未來，可能會招來災禍。所以，我們才藉助卡牌詢問未來。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Your fortune is a rather good one. There are some in this world who get more horrible fortunes.
scripts.translation: 你的預言已經算不錯了。這世上，有人得到的預言可怕得多。

scripts.text: Use this fortune as a support in your life. Ok?
scripts.translation: 把這份預言當作生活中的支援吧，好嗎？

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Someone that knows of the dangers you do not, will warn you in the form of cards... so listen carefully-!
scripts.translation: 有人知道你尚不知曉的危險，會借卡牌提醒你...所以，要仔細聽！

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Do you see the forbidden mark on its shoulder? It is telling you to not do something.
scripts.translation: 看見它肩膀上的禁止符號了嗎？它是在提醒你，有件事不能做。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: If you are thinking of something right now, stop your movement. Or else disaster may be headed your way.
scripts.translation: 你若正盤算著什麼，先停下行動。否則，災禍可能就要來了。

scripts.text: Someone is after you. The person is very strong like the picture. They might be holding grudges against you.
scripts.translation: 有人盯上你了。那個人像牌上畫的一樣強壯，可能對你懷恨在心。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Look around you. Of course, look for anyone you might have spited..
scripts.translation: 看看四周吧。當然，是看看你可能得罪過的人...

scripts.text: It is saying to be careful not to burn your mustache with a cigarette. When you do something, something is always at risk.. It is probably warning about that.
scripts.translation: 它提醒你，抽菸時別燒到鬍子。做什麼事，總會有些風險...大概就是在警告這個。

scripts.text: 'Be careful of shoveling'.. You might get hit by a shovel. Should you be careful around a construction site?
scripts.translation: “小心鏟土”...你可能會被鏟子打中。是不是該留意工地附近？

scripts.text: The sound of a moth's wings fluttering means chaos. A chaotic event may occur around you.
scripts.translation: 飛蛾振翅的聲音，意味著混亂。你身邊可能會發生一場亂子。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: The moth is warning you of this. You should be careful.
scripts.translation: 飛蛾正在警告你這一點。要多加小心。

scripts.text: Be aware of the wings. Wings symbolize flight, adventure, and fickleness of a player.
scripts.translation: 留意翅膀。它象徵著飛翔、冒險，以及花心之人的善變。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: If a word strikes you, be wary of that. Maybe.. a player?
scripts.translation: 如果哪個詞讓你心裡一動，就要留意它。也許...是個花心的人？

scripts.text: The teeth of Dustiness are very strong. This means.. Someone may attempt to bite you with their teeth?!
scripts.translation: 獵蠅的牙齒很堅硬。這意味著...有人可能會咬你？！

scripts.text: The moth's warning: 'Dangerous!'. A very simple, yet obvious warning.
scripts.translation: 飛蛾的警告是：“危險！”簡單，卻再明白不過。

scripts.text: Dracula says, 'Be careful in the streets at night.'
scripts.translation: 德古拉說：“晚上在街上要小心。”

scripts.text: Dracula says, 'Don't be too picky.'
scripts.translation: 德古拉說：“不要太挑剔。”

scripts.text: Dracula says, 'Brush your teeth 3 times a day.' Make sure you brush your teeth!
scripts.translation: 德古拉說：“每天刷牙3次。”可別忘了刷牙！

scripts.text: Dracula says, 'Study the important points first.' Cramming will not work!
scripts.translation: 德古拉說：“先學重點。”臨時抱佛腳可不行！

scripts.text: If you see the flag of a pirate, either run or do as they say. Pirates do not give more than one warning.
scripts.translation: 看見海盜旗，要麼逃跑，要麼聽他們的話。海盜不會警告第二次。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: It is the same in life.
scripts.translation: 生活中也是如此。

scripts.text: Pirates give warnings about many things. But right now, this card is speaking of betrayal.
scripts.translation: 海盜會對許多事情發出警告。可眼下，這張牌說的是背叛。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: To pirates, betrayal means tragic death. Be careful of betrayals.
scripts.translation: 對海盜來說，背叛意味著慘死。當心背叛。

scripts.text: The pirate is warning you of your beauty. Don't show off your beauty too much. Pirates are very jealous of appearance, as well.
scripts.translation: 海盜對你的美貌發出了警告。別太炫耀自己的美貌，他們也很嫉妒別人的容貌。

scripts.text: The Marina is warning of a hot stinging poison. Be cautious of poison.
scripts.translation: 水母提醒你，當心灼熱刺痛的毒。要提防毒素。

scripts.text: The Marina is warning about a lazy lifestyle. It says such a lifestyle will lead to something like itself.
scripts.translation: 水母提醒你，別過懶散的日子。它說，這麼下去，就會變得和它一樣。

scripts.text: The Marina doesn't really think about anything else.. But it will say one thing. Food. The Marina loves food.
scripts.translation: 水母不怎麼想別的事...不過，它會提起一件事：食物。它最愛吃了。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Eating is happiness. Same goes for humans as well. Value food and enjoy eating.
scripts.translation: 吃東西是件幸福的事，人也一樣。珍惜食物，好好享受吃飯吧。

scripts.text: The Marina is warning about a big belly. It's not happy because it resembles itself.. How about losing some weight?
scripts.translation: 水母提醒你，當心大肚子。它不高興，是因為那模樣太像它自己...不妨減減肥？

scripts.text: The Marionette says that you must not rely on violence and to use a different method.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃說，別依賴暴力，要換個辦法。

scripts.text: I'm not quite sure, but it may become an important word of advice to you..?
scripts.translation: 我也不太確定，不過，這也許會是對你很重要的一句忠告...？

scripts.text: The Marionette is warning about ominous activities. If you did something recently, you should settle it soon.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃在警告某些不祥的舉動。你最近若做過什麼，最好儘快處理妥當。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: A bad result may come your way.
scripts.translation: 你可能會遇到不好的結果。

scripts.text: The Marionette's eyes are warning about your falsehood. Lies, deceit, fake calculations and actions.. The Marionette is warning about all of them.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃的眼睛，在警告你別弄虛作假。謊言、欺騙、虛假的盤算和行動...這些，它都在警告。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: This is all for you young one. Therefore, follow this fortune and rid yourself of falsehood.
scripts.translation: 年輕人，這些都是為你好。所以，聽聽這次占卜的指引，改掉弄虛作假的毛病。

scripts.text: The Marionette is emphasizing a proper diet. Don't rely too much on meat.
scripts.translation: 傀儡娃娃強調，飲食要合理。別光顧著吃肉。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Take the Marionette's advice. She never says anything wrong. Hoho...
scripts.translation: 聽傀儡娃娃的建議吧，她說的從不會錯。呵呵...

scripts.text: The Medusa punishes those who challenge it without warning. Unexpected punishment.
scripts.translation: 米杜沙會毫無預警地懲罰挑戰它的人。懲罰來得突如其來。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: That is a Medusa. You should be careful. The warning ended a long time ago.
scripts.translation: 這就是米杜沙。你得小心，警告早就已經結束了。

scripts.text: The Medusa is warning you to be nice to others, or else it will turn you into stone.
scripts.translation: 米杜沙警告你，要善待別人，否則就把你變成石頭。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: What a rightful Medusa. Hmm...
scripts.translation: 真是個正直的米杜沙。嗯...

scripts.text: The Medusa is warning you to return anything you borrow on time.
scripts.translation: 米杜沙提醒你，借了東西要按時歸還。

scripts.text: Saying it will not forgive those who use other's things like a black hole.. borrowing and never returning
scripts.translation: 那些像黑洞一樣，把別人的東西借去就不還的人...它可不會原諒。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Are you sure you returned everything you have borrowed? Better take care of everything before you get punished.
scripts.translation: 借過的東西，你確定都還了嗎？最好趕在受罰之前，把這些事處理好。

scripts.text: The Medusa is warning about a person near you. Of their existence.. and the relationship,
scripts.translation: 米杜沙提醒你，留意身邊的某個人。那個人的存在...以及你們之間的關係。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: The Medusa's warning is very stern. Take a close look around you.
scripts.translation: 米杜沙的警告很嚴厲。仔細看看身邊吧。

scripts.text: The Baphomet says to beware when intervening with others' issues.
scripts.translation: 巴風特說，插手別人的事，要多加小心。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: He is very angry about intruding in others' spaces. Accept the Baphomet's warning.
scripts.translation: 巴風特很討厭別人侵入他人的地盤。聽聽它的警告吧。

scripts.text: The Baphomet is warning about arrogance. Even a strong and wise warrior must show respect to a Baphomet,
scripts.translation: 巴風特在警告你，別傲慢。再強大、再聰明的戰士，也得對它心懷敬意。

scripts.text: Arrogance takes away that respect. The Baphomet hates that type of arrogance.
scripts.translation: 傲慢會讓人失去敬意，而它最討厭這種傲慢。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Maybe it means he sees that type of arrogance in you? Since the Baphomet is warning you..
scripts.translation: 既然巴風特在警告你...也許，是它在你身上看到了那種傲慢？

scripts.text: The Baphomet is warning about the laziness that stops one from sharpening the scythe.
scripts.translation: 巴風特警告你，別懶得磨鐮刀。

scripts.text: That laziness will cause you to lose your life in an instant.
scripts.translation: 這樣的懶惰，會讓你轉眼間丟了命。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Laziness is more dangerous than the monster in front of you. Don't forget about this warning.
scripts.translation: 懶惰比眼前的魔物更危險。別忘了這個警告。

scripts.text: The Baphomet says it has nothing to say. I wonder why? Isn't it a very good sign?!!
scripts.translation: 巴風特說，它沒什麼可說的。為什麼呢？這不正是個好兆頭嗎？！

scripts.text: Sand is an instant cure of athlete's foot. He says to beware of athlete's foot and that he hates those rubbing their infected feet into his body.
scripts.translation: 沙子能立刻治好腳氣。它提醒你當心腳氣，也討厭別人把感染的腳蹭在它身上。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: A Sandman's warning is very stern. Wash your feet regularly, young one.
scripts.translation: 泥人的警告很嚴厲。年輕人，記得勤洗腳。

scripts.text: A chicken puts sand in its mouth to aid its insufficient digestion system.
scripts.translation: 雞會吃些沙子，彌補消化能力的不足。

scripts.text: The Sandman says to watch out before you become like a chicken.
scripts.translation: 泥人提醒你，多加小心，別弄得和雞一樣。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: And don't eat too much spicy and salty food, alcohol, etc. What a thoughtful Sandman.
scripts.translation: 還有，辛辣、過鹹的食物和酒之類的，也別攝入太多。真是個體貼的泥人。

scripts.text: The Sandman says over-sleepers will be punished by society!
scripts.translation: 泥人說，貪睡的人會受到社會的懲罰！

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Oooh, a stern warning about the future! Young one, bear this in mind.
scripts.translation: 噢，這是對未來的嚴厲警告！年輕人，記在心裡。

scripts.text: One warning from the Sandman, respect your parents.
scripts.translation: 泥人有句忠告：尊重父母。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: If you don't, you will end up like him. Listen to the Sandman.
scripts.translation: 不然，你就會變成它那樣。聽泥人的話吧。

scripts.text: Sohee dislikes stinky feet. Don't forget to wash your feet.
scripts.translation: 鬼女討厭臭腳。別忘了洗腳。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Bah, don't laugh about it! This is a solemn warning.
scripts.translation: 哼，別笑！這可是嚴肅的警告。

scripts.text: Sohee stands on the tip of her toes. It is because her toes are very strong.
scripts.translation: 鬼女踮著腳尖站立，因為她的腳趾很有力。

scripts.text: No matter what a person does, physical strength is the most important. Exercise and get stronger.
scripts.translation: 不管做什麼，體力都是最重要的。鍛鍊身體，讓自己更強壯吧。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: If you sit around all day, even the things that were going to work won't. Got it? Exercise, exercise!
scripts.translation: 整天坐著不動，連原本能成的事，也會做不成。明白了嗎？運動，運動！

scripts.text: Look at Sohee's hairstyle. Isn't it splendid.
scripts.translation: 看看鬼女的髮型，是不是很漂亮？

scripts.text: Sohee likes to take care of her appearance. If you don't, Sohee will get mad at you.
scripts.translation: 她喜歡打理自己的外表。你要是不注意儀容，她可是會生氣的。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Making yourself look presentable is just as important as keeping a good heart.
scripts.translation: 把自己收拾得體，和保持善良的心一樣重要。

scripts.text: Take care of your appearance. And get that pepper out from between your teeth!
scripts.translation: 注意儀容。還有，把牙縫裡的辣椒弄出來！

scripts.text: Once, Sohee didn't get her change back when she asked a baby ghost to run an errand.
scripts.translation: 有一次，鬼女讓小鬼跑腿，結果小鬼沒把零錢還給她。這可不行！

scripts.text: No can do! Always return the change.
scripts.translation: 剩下的零錢，一定要還。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: No matter how little the amount, you must not just keep it. Sohee greatly dislikes it.
scripts.translation: 金額再小，也不能私自留下。鬼女最討厭這樣。

scripts.text: Even though it is a skeleton with only bones, it has all the safety gear needed.
scripts.translation: 雖然它只是副骨架，安全裝備卻一樣不少。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: What the skeleton wants to say is, be aware of 'safety'. Being ignorant about safety is dangerous.
scripts.translation: 邪骸戰士想說的是，要重視“安全”。對安全一無所知，可是很危險的。

scripts.text: The skeleton card has a gray tone. If you read the grey, you can see the darkness.
scripts.translation: 邪骸戰士牌是灰色調的。細看那片灰色，就能看見黑暗。

scripts.text: It seems like darkness is on its way. Be careful, this darkness isn't ordinary.
scripts.translation: 黑暗似乎正在逼近。小心，這不是尋常的黑暗。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Hmm.. would you like an amulet?
scripts.translation: 嗯...要不要一個護身符？

scripts.text: The skeleton is warning you about an irregular eating pattern.
scripts.translation: 邪骸戰士提醒你，別吃得沒規律。

scripts.text: It says it became like that because of a bad eating habit.
scripts.translation: 它說，自己就是飲食習慣不好，才變成這樣的。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Eat the right food at the right time. That's the only way your body will survive. You can't afford to become like a skeleton.
scripts.translation: 按時吃飯，也要吃得合適，身體才能撐下去。可不能把自己弄得像副骷髏。

scripts.text: The skeleton's pickaxe is very strong. Even though its body seems weak, with the right tools, it can do great things.
scripts.translation: 邪骸戰士的鎬頭很厲害。身子看著雖弱，有了合適的工具，也能做成大事。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: So don't blame your body right now and go search for the right tools. Then you will have a good result.
scripts.translation: 所以，別隻怪自己身體不行，去找合適的工具吧。這樣，就會有好結果。

scripts.text: The knight is warning you of reckless driving. Do you ride a Pecopeco by any chance?
scripts.translation: 騎士提醒你，別莽撞地騎行。你該不會騎著大嘴鳥吧？

scripts.text: Anyhow, you should avoid reckless driving.. If a knight is saying that, it is a big problem.
scripts.translation: 總之，別橫衝直撞...連騎士都這麼說，問題可不小。

scripts.text: The knight is warning you of cruelty. It could be yours or that of someone around you.
scripts.translation: 騎士提醒你，當心殘忍。可能是你自己的，也可能來自身邊的人。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Anyhow, cruelty will harm you for sure. Be cautious of it.
scripts.translation: 總之，殘忍一定會傷到你。多加小心。

scripts.text: The misfortune shown in the knight card is hastiness. That is also what takes away a knight's life, too.
scripts.translation: 騎士牌所警示的，是急躁。這也會奪走騎士的性命。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: This knight is warning you from the bottom of his heart,
scripts.translation: 這位騎士是真心在提醒你，別重蹈他的覆轍。

scripts.text: so that you don't repeat his mistake. Be ware of hastiness.
scripts.translation: 不要急躁。

scripts.text: This knight is warning you of loneliness. He doesn't have a person to help his horse,
scripts.translation: 這位騎士提醒你，當心孤獨。

scripts.text: nor a lover awaiting him, so loneliness hits him in the heart.
scripts.translation: 沒人替他照料馬匹，也沒有愛人等他歸來，孤獨便刺進了他的心。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Loneliness is not simply sadness. It is a formless devil eating your life. Stay away from loneliness.
scripts.translation: 孤獨不只是悲傷，而是吞噬生命的無形惡魔。遠離孤獨。

scripts.text: The warning of the god of death is death itself.
scripts.translation: 死神發出的警告就是死亡本身。

scripts.text: [Lhimetorra]
scripts.translation: [利梅托拉]

scripts.text: Be cautious of death.. death that can be your turn, or maybe someone else.
scripts.translation: 當心死亡...可能輪到你，也可能是別人。

scripts.text: The Anubis is warning you of hatred. Hatred only brings upon death.
scripts.translation: 安畢斯提醒你，當心仇恨。仇恨只會帶來死亡。

scripts.text: The Anubis must not like being busy these days.

scripts.translation: 學著接受別人的意見吧。不如先從獸人酋長的意見開始？

scripts.text: Agh! Don't die from studying! Take breaks while you're at it! You need some rest!
scripts.translation: 啊！別學習學得連命都沒了！中途也要歇一歇，你需要休息！

scripts.text: Oh, no! You're missing the main points! Figure out the essentials!
scripts.translation: 糟糕！你沒抓住重點！先弄清最關鍵的內容吧！

scripts.text: Mmph! You're dying not to study! At times like this, a break is the best!
scripts.translation: 唔！你簡直一點兒也不想學了！這種時候，休息最管用！

scripts.text: Studying is just like hunting a monster in the desert. Resting for a little is the best. Understand?
scripts.translation: 學習就像在沙漠裡打怪，最好中途歇一歇。明白了嗎？

scripts.text: A nice cup of cold juice under the hot sun! Studying should be done like that, too!
scripts.translation: 烈日下，喝一杯冰涼的果汁多舒服！學習時也要這樣調劑一下！

scripts.text: Even though it is the desert, you seem to have a relaxed smile! Maybe you need to relax like this when studying as well!
scripts.translation: 明明身在沙漠，卻笑得很輕鬆！也許學習時，你也該這樣放鬆一下！

scripts.text: Your grades are in danger! You must study harder!
scripts.translation: 你的成績危險啦！得再努力學才行！

scripts.text: There may be a big crisis! Don't get too stressed just because you can't study!
scripts.translation: 可能會有大危機！可也別因為學不進去，就給自己太大壓力！

scripts.text: It is saying studying in the dark night can be dangerous! Careful when studying at night!
scripts.translation: 卡牌說，深夜學習可能有危險！晚上學習要小心哦！

scripts.text: Studying came to a strange place! It needs to find its original path! You can do it!
scripts.translation: 學習走偏啦！得找回原來的路！你能做到！

scripts.text: You're gazing at a smart friend with the eyes of a Poring! Heehee! Doing good!
scripts.translation: 你正用波利的眼神，望著聰明的朋友！嘿嘿，做得不錯！

scripts.text: Eh? You're too smart! You're at a much higher level than your friends! Take a break!
scripts.translation: 咦？你太聰明了！水平比朋友們高出一大截！歇一歇吧！

scripts.text: You will be rewarded for your accomplishments! It was worth the effort!
scripts.translation: 你的學習成果會得到獎勵！努力沒有白費！

scripts.text: Forget about studying for a moment and enjoy the party! It should be refreshing~!
scripts.translation: 先把學習放一邊，享受派對吧！會讓你精神煥發~！

scripts.text: Study something that will make people happy! Future set!
scripts.translation: 學些能讓人開心的東西吧！未來就有著落啦！

scripts.text: If you're not sure of something, ask a friend! It's not something to be ashamed about! You can do it!
scripts.translation: 有不明白的，就問朋友！這沒什麼丟人的！你能做到！

scripts.text: Don't think that your head is empty! Because, you are smart! You can do it!
scripts.translation: 別覺得自己腦袋空空！你很聰明，能做到的！

scripts.text: There's a phenomenon you don't understand! Do a little more research! You'll be able to figure it out soon!
scripts.translation: 碰到了不明白的現象！再研究一下，很快就能弄懂啦！

scripts.text: Don't get lazy about studying wherever you go! Seek the road of truth and go down it to find the answer!
scripts.translation: 不管走到哪裡，學習都別偷懶！沿著追求真理的路走下去，就能找到答案！

scripts.text: You need strength to study! Get stronger! Running is a start!
scripts.translation: 學習也得有體力！讓自己強壯起來，先從跑步開始吧！

scripts.text: You will become an admirable person because of all the effort put into studying! You must feel very worth while!
scripts.translation: 學習上的努力，會讓你成為令人敬佩的人！你一定覺得這些付出很值得吧！

scripts.text: Try studying the history of our country! From when the tiger started smoking!
scripts.translation: 學學我們國家的歷史吧！就從老虎開始抽菸的年代學起！

scripts.text: You must be having a hard time studying because of all the pressure! Go out and get some fresh air!
scripts.translation: 壓力這麼大，你一定學得很辛苦！出去透透氣吧！

scripts.text: Your head seems to be heavy because of studying! You need a diversion! Put studying aside for a moment!
scripts.translation: 學習學得腦袋都沉甸甸了！換換心情，先把學習放一放吧！

scripts.text: Try studying aerospace or meteorology! Don't you think it would be fun?
scripts.translation: 試試學航空航天或氣象學吧！是不是很有趣？

scripts.text: How about studying theology? You even get to study about angels!
scripts.translation: 不如學神學？還能研究天使呢！

scripts.text: Study little by little and make yourself feel lighter! You can't study if you're overloaded with words!
scripts.translation: 一點一點學，讓自己輕鬆些！腦袋裡塞了太多文字，反而學不進去！

scripts.text: When studying, you should have a snack! It may seem trivial, but it is rather important!
scripts.translation: 學習時，吃點零食吧！看著是小事，其實很重要哦！

scripts.text: Even when you are sick, don't forget about studying! Where there is effort, there is bound to be good results!
scripts.translation: 就算生病，也別忘了學習！有努力，就一定有好結果！

scripts.text: Newton discovered gravity through a falling apple! Be wary of even the little things in your surroundings!
scripts.translation: 牛頓從落下的蘋果發現了引力！身邊的小事，也要留心哦！

scripts.text: Green is good for studying! Color your walls green or get a green drink! The lucky color! Green!
scripts.translation: 綠色有助於學習！把牆刷成綠色，或者找杯綠色飲料吧！幸運色！綠色！

scripts.text: There is a jewel in your mind! You need to bring all the wisdom to life! Don't study bad things!
scripts.translation: 你的腦袋裡有顆寶石！把智慧都發揮出來吧，可別學壞！

scripts.text: You will receive good results from studying! You can focus on your current studies!
scripts.translation: 學習會有好結果！專心學眼下的內容就好！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: You've been told your study fortune! Was it a good one?
scripts.translation: 學業運勢佔完啦！結果不錯嗎？

scripts.text: But in studying, effort is more important than any type of fortune!
scripts.translation: 不過，學習這件事，努力比什麼運勢都重要！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: Try your best. Then, see you again! Byyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyeeeee~~byyyyeeee~
scripts.translation: 好好加油！那就下次再見啦！拜~~~~拜~~拜~

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: Relationships among friends is more difficult than people think! Let's use the cards to try and solve this complicated puzzle of friendship!
scripts.translation: 朋友間的相處，比大家想的還難！就用卡牌，解開這個複雜的友誼謎題吧！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: Ah! Your friend has gone crazy! They need the heal of friendship!
scripts.translation: 啊！你的朋友瘋啦！需要用友誼來治癒！

scripts.text: Mmm! You both have gone crazy. You must overcome it through conversations!
scripts.translation: 唔！你們倆都瘋啦！得好好聊聊，才能解決！

scripts.text: Agh! You are suffering because of your friend! Try opening your heart and be more lenient!
scripts.translation: 啊！朋友讓你受苦了！敞開心扉，試著寬容一些吧！

scripts.text: You even split a pea between friends! Don't be so cruel. Reflect upon yourself and apologize!
scripts.translation: 和朋友連一顆豌豆都要分清！別這麼狠心，反省一下，去道歉吧！

scripts.text: Oh no! Your friend is ignoring you! Offer a bottle of juice to your friend! Your friendship may come back?
scripts.translation: 糟糕！朋友不理你啦！送瓶果汁給對方吧，說不定就能恢復友誼？

scripts.text: Eh!? What kind of friendship is this?! Hurry up and make up!
scripts.translation: 咦！？這算哪門子友誼？！趕快和好吧！

scripts.text: Oh no?! This person is not your friend, but an enemy! You must be careful!
scripts.translation: 糟了？！這人不是朋友，是敵人！你得小心！

scripts.text: Your friend is in danger! You must help your friend!
scripts.translation: 朋友有危險！快去幫忙！

scripts.text: Your friendship is on the verge of falling apart! Cast a shield around your friendship!
scripts.translation: 你們的友誼快破裂啦！快給它撐起一道護盾！

scripts.text: One person is left out amongst your friends! Be more friendly!
scripts.translation: 朋友裡，有個人被冷落了！對人家友善些吧！

scripts.text: Your friend hit you! Don't cry even if it may hurt! Hurry and make up!
scripts.translation: 朋友打你了！再疼也別哭，趕快和好吧！

scripts.text: You must be alone! It must be hard to make friends! Try putting on a brighter face!
scripts.translation: 你一定是獨自一人，交朋友很難吧！試著讓表情開朗一些！

scripts.text: Give your friends a present! Your friendship will become deeper!
scripts.translation: 給朋友們送份禮物吧！友誼會更深厚！

scripts.text: Prepare a hat to cover your friend's large head! They will be moved by your care!
scripts.translation: 準備一頂帽子，給朋友的大腦袋戴上吧！這份體貼，會讓對方很感動！

scripts.text: A friend is waiting for you! Be nice to your friend!
scripts.translation: 有朋友正等著你！對人家好一點哦！

scripts.text: Being close friends despite differences is true friendship! Shelter each other's differences!
scripts.translation: 彼此不同，卻依然親密，這才是真正的友誼！包容彼此的差異吧！

scripts.text: Your misunderstandings will be removed if you take the time to talk! Go have a conversation with your friend!
scripts.translation: 花點時間好好聊，誤會就能解開！去找朋友談談吧！

scripts.text: When a friend is sick, visit them! They will be happy! For sure!
scripts.translation: 朋友病了，就去探望！對方一定很開心！一定！

scripts.text: Go out and have some fun with your friend! Your friendship will surely get stronger!
scripts.translation: 和朋友出去玩吧！你們的友誼一定會更牢固！

scripts.text: Give your friend a present! They'll go bragging around town?!
scripts.translation: 給朋友送份禮物吧！對方說不定會滿鎮子炫耀？！

scripts.text: Share your bone with your friend! Sacrifices in friendship are beautiful!
scripts.translation: 把你的骨頭分給朋友吧！為友誼犧牲，可是很美好的！

scripts.text: Do anything for your friend! With all your heart and soul! Your friend will be delighted!
scripts.translation: 為朋友做什麼都行！全心全意地去做，對方會很開心！

scripts.text: No smoking, even with a friend! Stop smoking for your health!
scripts.translation: 和朋友在一起，也不許抽菸！為了健康，戒菸吧！

scripts.text: You and your friend will encounter hardships! Combine your powers and overcome it!
scripts.translation: 你和朋友會遇上困難！齊心協力，一起克服吧！

scripts.text: Go on a trip with your friend! Friendship can get stronger in new environments!
scripts.translation: 和朋友去旅行吧！新的環境，能讓友誼更牢固！

scripts.text: Give your friend a ride in a plane! They'll probably fly with joy!?
scripts.translation: 讓朋友坐趟飛機吧！對方說不定會開心得飛起來？！

scripts.text: Don't forget your friend in heaven! Friendship is eternal!
scripts.translation: 別忘了天堂裡的朋友！友誼永恆！

scripts.text: Help your friend's scar. Your friend would greatly appreciate it!
scripts.translation: 幫朋友撫平傷痕吧！對方會很感激你！

scripts.text: You even split a slice of an apple among friends! Share more things with your friend! Something good will happen!
scripts.translation: 連一片蘋果，你都願意和朋友分！多和朋友分享些東西吧，會有好事發生！

scripts.text: When your friend is sleeping, think of them! Then there will be progress in your friendship! What do you think~ it means~?!
scripts.translation: 朋友睡著時，也替對方想想吧！這樣，友誼就能更進一步！你覺得~這是什麼意思~？！

scripts.text: Don't measure friendship with money! If you do, be careful for there will be a crack in your friendship!
scripts.translation: 別用錢衡量友誼！不然，可要當心友誼出現裂痕！

scripts.text: It seems as if your friend will give you many presents! Look forward to it!
scripts.translation: 看來，朋友會送你很多禮物！期待一下吧！

scripts.text: You must be lonely without a friend! A good friend will come along soon!
scripts.translation: 沒有朋友，你一定很寂寞！別急，好朋友很快就會出現！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: Poring fortunetelling works very well when it is about friendship!
scripts.translation: 問友誼，波利牌占卜特別靈！

scripts.text: It is the heart of the poring card that earnestly hopes for good friendships!
scripts.translation: 因為波利牌真心盼著，大家都能擁有美好的友誼！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: Did you like it? Next time invite your friend! Then byebye!!
scripts.translation: 喜歡嗎？下次把朋友也帶來吧！那就拜拜啦！！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: If you say fortunetelling! Of course it is about the future! Let's try to figure this out!
scripts.translation: 說到占卜，當然少不了未來！來看看吧！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: Oh no! You are not confident about the future! Trust yourself a little more! Hope!
scripts.translation: 糟糕！你對未來沒信心！多相信自己一點，要有希望！

scripts.text: Oh! Do you keep on thinking about your death in the future! First, forget about death and live your life!
scripts.translation: 哦！你總想著自己將來會死嗎？！先忘掉死亡，好好過日子吧！

scripts.text: Cut! You are filled with uncertainty about the future! Let's get rid of this! Wee! It's gone!
scripts.translation: 咔！你對未來滿是不安！把不安清掉吧！嘿！沒啦！

scripts.text: Life may seem like a hot and dry desert, but in the future, delicious juice and rest awaits you!
scripts.translation: 生活也許像炎熱乾燥的沙漠，可未來有美味的果汁和休息等著你！

scripts.text: Even in a hot and dry desert, isn't the future happier since you can encounter sweet juice? Put forth your strength!
scripts.translation: 即使身在炎熱乾燥的沙漠，想著將來能喝到甜甜的果汁，不也很幸福嗎？加把勁！

scripts.text: Don't your troubles disappear watching a poring smile? Your future must be filled with good things!
scripts.translation: 看見波利的笑容，煩惱是不是就散了？你的未來，一定有很多好事！

scripts.text: There is danger waiting ahead! You should avoid it for now! Take care of yourself!
scripts.translation: 前面有危險等著你！先避開它，好好保護自己！

scripts.text: You must be fearing your future!? Don't worry too much! Think of happy thoughts!
scripts.translation: 你是不是很害怕未來？！別太擔心，多想想開心的事！

scripts.text: You may endanger someone in the future! Don't become a bad person~!
scripts.translation: 你將來可能會危及別人！可別變成壞人哦~！

scripts.text: You may have to stand alone in the future! Prepare yourself right now!
scripts.translation: 將來，你可能得獨自面對一切！現在就做好準備吧！

scripts.text: Many hardships await you in the future! But you can overcome them!
scripts.translation: 未來有很多困難等著你！不過，你能克服它們！

scripts.text: You might not even be able to buy summer clothes in the future! Don't waste your money!
scripts.translation: 將來，你說不定連夏裝都買不起！別亂花錢哦！

scripts.text: Something exciting may happen! What can it be? Fun! Fun!
scripts.translation: 可能會發生令人興奮的事！是什麼呢？好玩！好玩！

scripts.text: Something good might happen on this nice day! You can look forward to it! Yay!
scripts.translation: 這麼美好的日子，說不定會有好事發生！期待一下吧！耶！

scripts.text: A splendid event will be held! Go get ready! Look forward to it!
scripts.translation: 會有一場精彩的活動！快去準備，好好期待吧！

scripts.text: You will meet someone new! It will be very interesting!
scripts.translation: 你會認識一個新的人！會很有趣哦！

scripts.text: If you go little by little, something good will happen! Sit and take a look around you!
scripts.translation: 一步一步來，就會有好事！坐下來，看看四周吧！

scripts.text: You get a headache from thinking about the future? Empty your mind! You will feel refreshed!
scripts.translation: 一想未來，就頭疼嗎？清空思緒，你就會輕鬆多啦！

scripts.text: You will become a respectable person in the future! Good job!
scripts.translation: 你將來會成為受人尊敬的人！真棒！

scripts.text: I can see you working hard in the future! What a lively future!
scripts.translation: 我看見你將來努力工作的模樣了！真是充滿活力的未來！

scripts.text: You have a very busy future! Take care of your health!
scripts.translation: 你將來會很忙！要照顧好身體哦！

scripts.text: Pick a job where you can work with other people! It will be very rewarding, right?
scripts.translation: 選份能和別人一起做的工作吧！一定會很有成就感，對吧？

scripts.text: Try doing some volunteer work! It is worthwhile and you will feel good about it, too!
scripts.translation: 試著做些志願服務吧！既有意義，自己也會很開心！

scripts.text: You may become a commander! Mmm~! Kind of scary!
scripts.translation: 你可能會成為指揮官！唔~！有點嚇人呢！

scripts.text: Choose a job that involves flying! You show potential!
scripts.translation: 選份和飛行有關的工作吧！你很有潛力！

scripts.text: Scrumptious ice cream that could even be eaten in heaven! Challenge yourself and get involved in a job making things of that sort!
scripts.translation: 美味得連天堂裡都能吃到的冰淇淋！挑戰一下自己，找份製作這類東西的工作吧！

scripts.text: In the future, things that cannot be done right now will be accomplished! You can look forward to it!
scripts.translation: 現在做不到的事，將來會實現！好好期待吧！

scripts.text: Little things in life will bring you happiness and joy in the future! Even more than now!
scripts.translation: 生活中的小事，會在將來帶給你幸福和快樂！比現在還多哦！

scripts.text: Do what you have to do. Live life to the fullest, even though the world may end tomorrow!
scripts.translation: 做好該做的事！就算世界明天會毀滅，也要盡情活好今天！

scripts.text: You will deal with fruits in the future! How about preparing yourself?
scripts.translation: 你將來會和水果打交道！不妨先做好準備？

scripts.text: Your future self will encounter a high wall! Although, I'm not sure what type of building it may be!
scripts.translation: 將來的你，會遇上一堵高牆！不過，我也不知道是什麼建築的牆！

scripts.text: Green symbolizes peace! Your future seems as if it will be very peaceful! It's a good thing, right?
scripts.translation: 綠色象徵著和平！你的未來看來很安寧！這是好事，對吧？

scripts.text: Romance lays ahead in your future! Relax yourself and prepare yourself!
scripts.translation: 浪漫正在未來等著你！放鬆些，做好準備吧！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: What do you think? Has your anxiety been relieved after hearing your fortune?
scripts.translation: 怎麼樣？聽完運勢，是不是不那麼焦慮了？

scripts.text: This is only a small part of your future! You must discover the rest!
scripts.translation: 這只是未來的一小部分，剩下的要靠你自己去發現！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: Am I cheesy? I'm just like that! Then, bye~~~~ye~~~ye~~~~!!
scripts.translation: 是不是很肉麻？我就是這樣嘛！那就拜~~~~拜~~~~！！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: Mmm! The long awaited time has come! Asking a question about money to the cute Poring!
scripts.translation: 唔！期待已久的時刻到了！要向可愛的波利問財運啦！

scripts.text: Ok! Let's try it!
scripts.translation: 好，來試試！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: Uh oh! You're about to be robbed! You must save a little first!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！你快被搶啦！得先存點錢！

scripts.text: Kek! Your mind goes blank when you think about money! Think of other thoughts! Forget about money for a while!
scripts.translation: 嘿！你一想到錢，腦袋就空白了！想點別的，先把錢放一邊吧！

scripts.text: Bah! This isn't a time to think about money. Calm down and put your mind at ease!
scripts.translation: 哼！現在可不是想錢的時候！冷靜下來，放寬心吧！

scripts.text: If you look carefully, it is not drinking juice, but underground water through a straw in the ground! Money is hidden where nobody expects! Good luck searching!
scripts.translation: 仔細看，它喝的不是果汁，而是用插進地裡的吸管喝地下水！錢就藏在誰都想不到的地方！祝你找得順利！

scripts.text: As you can quench your thirst in the dry desert, you can gather money even in this difficult world!
scripts.translation: 乾燥的沙漠裡，也能找到水解渴！同樣，再艱難的世道，你也能攢下錢！

scripts.text: Just like the juice inside the needles of a cactus, you can still gather wealth though you may be in anguish. You can do it!
scripts.translation: 就像仙人掌刺裡的汁液，身處痛苦，也能積聚財富！你能做到！

scripts.text: Agh! Someone is after your possessions! Be careful!
scripts.translation: 啊！有人盯上你的財物了！要小心！

scripts.text: Uh oh! Someone is after your money! Take good care of it!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！有人打你錢的主意！可得保管好！

scripts.text: It says you might be tempted to do something bad to gather money! Don't forget about a kind heart!
scripts.translation: 卡牌說，你可能會受誘惑，為了賺錢去做壞事！別忘了心存善意！

scripts.text: You have hidden money in your clothes! Hidden rich one! Be careful not to be caught!
scripts.translation: 你把錢藏在衣服裡啦！原來是個不露富的有錢人！小心別被發現！

scripts.text: In the future, it seems like you will be kicking money around with your feet like those Porings! Congratulations!
scripts.translation: 看來，你將來會像那些波利一樣，用腳踢著錢玩！恭喜！

scripts.text: You must be exhausted! Making money is not the easiest thing to do! But it will be that much more valuable!
scripts.translation: 你一定累壞了！賺錢不容易，可也正因如此，才更有價值！

scripts.text: Your tendency to spend money is growing! Be careful! Don't be left empty-handed!
scripts.translation: 你越來越想花錢啦！小心，別花到兩手空空！

scripts.text: Use your money to buy something fun! Then good luck will be headed your way!
scripts.translation: 花錢買些好玩的東西吧！好運就會來找你！

scripts.text: Use your money on something exciting! It looks as if good luck will be headed your way!
scripts.translation: 把錢花在令人興奮的事上吧！看來，好運要來啦！

scripts.text: It seems like you will have two lucky offerings! Don't miss these two opportunities!
scripts.translation: 你會有兩次幸運的機遇！兩個都別錯過！

scripts.text: Doesn't it seem like there should be money in the small wallet? You will have some small income! Save money wisely!
scripts.translation: 小錢包裡，應該也有錢吧？你會有一筆小收入！好好攢錢哦！

scripts.text: So~ empty. Upsetting, but don't worry too much about money! Something better ought to happen!
scripts.translation: 好~空啊！真讓人難過！可也別太為錢發愁，會有更好的事發生！

scripts.text: Someone will return something you lost! What a relief!
scripts.translation: 有人會把你丟失的東西還回來！真讓人鬆口氣！

scripts.text: No need to worry about osteoporosis! Wasn't it a good thing to eat so much calcium? Oops! This isn't about money?!
scripts.translation: 不用擔心骨質疏鬆！補了那麼多鈣，不是好事嗎？哎呀！這說的不是錢吧？！

scripts.text: Seeing that you work so hard, seems like you will make lots of money! Congratz~!
scripts.translation: 看你工作這麼努力，一定能賺不少錢！恭喜~！

scripts.text: Even if you save money, it disappears like smoke. Don't get too caught up with it!
scripts.translation: 錢就算攢下來，也會像煙一樣散掉。別太執著啦！

scripts.text: It's hard to make money, isn't it? But don't forget the good deeds in life!
scripts.translation: 賺錢很難，對吧？不過，也別忘了行善！

scripts.text: Going around to collect money might lead you to a scary person! Be very careful!
scripts.translation: 四處奔波收錢，可能會遇到可怕的人！一定要小心！

scripts.text: Forget about money and fly~fly! You will feel very refreshed!
scripts.translation: 忘掉錢，飛~飛起來吧！心情會很暢快！

scripts.text: Money is like clouds! Instead of money, think about a happy life!
scripts.translation: 錢就像浮雲！與其想著錢，不如想想幸福的生活！

scripts.text: Even if it may seem pointless, if you persist, you will be able to make lots of money! You can do it!
scripts.translation: 看著也許沒意義，可只要堅持，就能賺很多錢！你能做到！

scripts.text: Don't neglect the trivial things on the floor! If you keep an open heart like that, you will be able to collect money!
scripts.translation: 別忽視地上不起眼的小東西！保持這份敞開的心，你就能攢下錢！

scripts.text: If you work with something that is related to mushrooms or apples, a good fortune awaits you! What kind of work would that be?
scripts.translation: 做些和蘑菇或蘋果有關的工作，好運就等著你！會是什麼工作呢？

scripts.text: How can you think of money looking at such a peaceful card! That's not nice! Sniff..sniffles! Anyhow, it seems like you will gather much fortune!
scripts.translation: 看著這麼安寧的牌，你怎麼還想著錢！真不乖！*抽抽鼻子*！總之，看來你會積攢不少財富！

scripts.text: You have many fine stones! You will prosper if you are involved in this industry!
scripts.translation: 你有很多漂亮的石頭！從事這個行業，就能興旺發達！

scripts.text: It is an indication that you will prosper! No need to worry now!
scripts.translation: 這是興旺發達的預兆！現在不用擔心啦！

scripts.text: You will collect many treasures! But the problem is protecting all of it!
scripts.translation: 你會收集到很多寶物！不過，難的是把它們都守住！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: There is something you need to keep in mind after being told a fortune about wealth!
scripts.translation: 財運佔完，有件事得記住！不付出努力，

scripts.text: Money does not automatically come to one without effort! No matter how good the fortune, you must work diligently!
scripts.translation: 錢可不會自己找上門！運勢再好，也得勤奮工作！

scripts.text: [Chocarle]
scripts.translation: [巧卡爾]

scripts.text: Bear that in mind! Then, until we meet again.. *poof*!
scripts.translation: 記住哦！那就下次再見...*噗*！
